Headquarters: United States
URL: http://www.halcyon.ai

What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

The Role  

  

At Halcyon, we’re building a world-class anti-ransomware platform grounded in innovation and resilience. As part of that vision, we’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our cloud team. You’ll lead the development and evolution of our data platform and API services, working within a modern tech stack that blends Scala and Rust.   

You’ll join a team focused on building scalable, maintainable backend systems that serve both internal and customer-facing functions. Your primary focus will be on Rust and Scala services, with opportunities to shape our transition to Rust where it makes sense. Python development experience is highly valued, particularly for supporting our security analysis platform which includes malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning workflows.  

Responsibilities  

  • Lead the design and delivery of features across our data platform and public API services, including ingestion, transformation, and enrichment of security data. 
  • Drive system design, architecture, and data flow decisions in partnership with product and platform engineering. 
  • Build, deploy, and own Scala-based backend services in production, keeping them reliable, secure, and performant. 
  • Help shape and execute our migration of selected APIs from Scala to Rust, ensuring consistency and continuity along the way. 
  • Set the bar for code quality, documentation, and operational excellence.  
  • Lead design reviews, code reviews and take part in on-call and incident response. 
  • Support and enhance our Python-based security analysis platform, including malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning model workflows.  

Skills and Qualifications  

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with recent experience in a JVM-based codebase.  
  • A track record of designing and owning distributed systems from start to finish. 
  • Experience with Rust, or a well-formed view of when it’s the right tool, and the ability to help guide a migration. 
  • Strong understanding of APIs, messaging systems (Kafka), and modern data stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, OpenSearch).  
  • Experience building services in a cloud-native environment, preferably AWS.  
  • Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes.  
  • Comfortable working in a remote-first, asynchronous team environment.  

Bonus Skills and Qualifications  

  • Familiarity with functional programming patterns and idiomatic Scala.  
  • Experience with Databricks and ClickHouse (or similar lakehouse and analytical/OLAP data stores). 
  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, and GitHub Actions.  
  • Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).  
  • Prior work on security products, data pipelines, or high-availability systems.  
  • Python development experience, particularly with security analysis tools and malware detection frameworks (YARA, PE analysis, binary analysis).  
  • Familiarity with machine learning workflows, AutoML, and MLflow for model deployment and management.  
  • Experience with binary analysis libraries (LIEF, ssdeep, TLSH) and security tooling integration. 

Benefits:

 Halcyon offers the following benefits to eligible employees:

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents.

  • 401k plan with a generous employer contribution.

  • Short and long-term disability coverage, basic life and AD&D insurance plans.

  • Medical and dependent care FSA options.

  • Flexible PTO policy.

  • Parental leave.

  • Generous equity offering.

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​

Base Salary Range: $120,000 - $170,000

Bonus Target: 10%

In accordance with applicable state and federal laws, the range provided is Halcyon’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. Base pay is one part of the total package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and equity in the Company.

We understand it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, passionate, curious, and creative people to develop the exceptional product we are building. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

 

Your Role

We're looking for a Senior Scrum Master to join our team in London. Our products help the world's top teams and athletes perform at their best. We need an experienced Agile leader to help the squads building them do the same.

As a Senior ScrumMaster, you'll:

  • Coach the system, not just the team. You'll guide squads toward high autonomy while focusing on broader organizational design issues, such as resolving friction across business units, managing dependencies, and establishing scaling patterns.
  • Architect outcomes, not processes. You'll move fluidly across frameworks, adapting events to what the team needs to deliver value. You will act as an outcome architect, designing information flow and decision rhythms rather than functioning as a framework fundamentalist.
  • Anticipate, not react. You'll utilize predictive delivery intelligence and cross-team dependency mapping to resolve impediments before they surface, keeping coordination moving in the right direction even as the pace of delivery accelerates.
  • Foster psychological safety. You'll build environments where candor is safe, failure is treated as a data point, and conflict is constructive. You'll ensure teams feel secure enough to take on hard problems and navigate the shifting dynamics brought on by AI-assisted development.
  • Align and design for visibility. You'll map value streams to see where decisions stall and design cross-BU communication layers. You will maintain the signal through the noise, ensuring stakeholders know what's changed and what decisions are needed.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of our London office. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • An experienced Agile practitioner. You have three or more years as a Scrum Master and have guided squads to improved, sustainable results and can scale your coaching capacity to influence broader organizational maturity.
  • A systems thinker. You see beyond the squad level, actively identifying and breaking down siloed organizational designs to reduce friction and eliminate duplicated efforts across Business Units.
  • Data-driven and predictive. You know how to use both qualitative and quantitative signals to establish predictive metrics that forecast delivery risk and guide investment decisions.
  • A clear communicator. You design lightweight operating guardrails and information flows that keep dependencies transparent and align stakeholders at every level without creating overhead that slows teams down.
  • A champion of responsible speed. You optimize for quality, anticipated dependencies, commitments kept, and team sustainability, ensuring that the speed of code generation never outpaces our coordination speed.

Nice-to-Haves

  • AI fluency. You have an interest in or experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered agile tools, such as automated bottleneck detection or real-time sentiment and health monitoring.
  • A diverse Agile toolbelt. You're familiar with multiple frameworks (Kanban, Lean, SAFe, etc) and know when and how to blend them for better outcomes.
  • Global team experience. Our product teams span the U.S. and Europe, and you're comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. 

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion. 

Base Salary Range
£48,000—£80,000 GBP

Privacy Policy

description: SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing. We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale. Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation. You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows. WHAT YOU'LL DO Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain WHAT YOU'LL NEED 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflows Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainability Experience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutions Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional: Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2. Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions. In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud. WHY CATAPULT? We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life. We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance. Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness. We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better. Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do. All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Satellite Systems Engineer
description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital builds a space infrastructure providing a fast & simple path to orbit. Using different flight proven buses, we design, integrate and operate spacecrafts, to fly physical or virtual customers payloads. We handle entire missions from end to end, significantly reducing the lead-time and risk of a traditional space mission. As a Satellite Systems Engineer at Loft, you will work on one or several satellite missions simultaneously, each one flying a single/multi-payload configuration. You will be a technical reference for these missions, working closely with program manager and all the Loft teams: products development teams, flight and ground software, AIT and operations. Using flight proven satellite buses and Loft designed payload hub infrastructure, you will lead the development activities of the missions you are in charge of. About this Role: Serve as satellite systems engineer for one or more customer missions, representing Loft in technical discussions and reviews to accommodate and fly a variety of payloads Act as the internal payload subject-matter expert, interfacing with hardware and software teams to ensure end-to-end integration. Work with flight operations to develop the mission CONOPS, supporting the development of Service Level Agreements with Loft's customers Assist with program management and product management, including interfacing with customers on programmatic and schedule matters Review test plans and test results, and participate in the integration, test campaign, launch and in-orbit activities Accommodate customer missions on Loft’s rideshare programs, contributing to satellite-level budgets and analyses, V&V planning, CONOPS definition, AIT, and on-orbit operations. Must Haves: A minimum of 5 years of demonstrated experience as a spacecraft systems engineer, or equivalent experience in at least two different subsystems (ADCS, Mechanical, Thermal, Power, On-Board Electronics & Software, …) You have strong communication and organizational skills You challenge norms in aerospace engineering and testing activities and or experienced in fast-paced development environment You have experience in small satellite assembly, integration and test campaigns, and/or in spacecraft delivery to orbit You handle pressure positively and are always ready to put hands-on Nice to Haves: Experience with Python and Jupyter notebooks for analysis and simulation Exposure to different space payload technologies (e.g., RF, optical, radar, hosted compute,…) Exposure to in-orbit operations International experience Some of Our Awesome Benefits: Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best Health and life insurance, we care about your health Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand ) Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable * Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes. Who We Are Loft: Space Made Simple. Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. - Occuper un poste centré sur la vente aux clients existants et très varié, avec du cross-sell et de l'upsell mais aussi des composantes relationnelles et produit ;
- Connaître et vendre le produit le plus performant du marché, avec une capacité d’innovation prouvée année après année ;
- S’appuyer sur des équipes Ops et Marketing bien staffées et de haut niveau, au service de la performance des Sales au quotidien ;
- Pouvoir évoluer dans une équipe avec des profils divers, qui met l'accent sur la formation et l’accompagnement dès le premier jour ;
- Bénéficier d'un package attractif au variable déplafonné.

Les missions
  • Aller chercher de l'ARR supplémentaire et de la croissance via de l'upsell ou du cross-sell
  • Prévenir et minimiser l’attrition
  • Gérer, développer et nourrir un portefeuille de clients en développant des relations solides avec les utilisateurs et les décideurs
  • Contribuer au développement direct de notre produit en remontant les retours des clients aux équipes techniques et produits
  • Maintenir un niveau de satisfaction client élevé

  • Tu as une expérience de quelques années dans la vente, ou en tant que juriste.

  • Tu es autonome, curieux.se et apprends rapidement
  • Tu es à l'aise dans la communication orale et écrite, et tu parles parfaitement français
  • Tu es capable de gérer plusieurs tâches et de gérer des priorités changeantes dans des délais serrés
  • Tu es impatient.e de prendre ton téléphone et de discuter avec les clients

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

title: Design System Manager - Consultant.e
description: Mindset Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière . Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise. Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision , une stratégie claire , et une gouvernance solide . Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte. Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents, composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable. Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence. Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow sans friction . How we work together 🤝 Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.


What you'll be doing
  • Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business

title: Senior CRM Strategist
description:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Senior CRM Strategist 

Company: VML

Working Model: Hybrid working

Location: Sea Containers office, London, SE1

At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.

Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey building connected brands that drive growth for our clients. We do this by leveraging our 3 core practices; Brand experience, Customer experience and Commerce. Within these practices we offer expertise across communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.

The Role

As a Senior CRM Strategist, you'll be a key strategic voice within the team, working closely with Client Services, Creative and other disciplines to turn business challenges into effective, customer-focused solutions.

In this role, you’ll focus on one of our major automotive accounts, helping shape CRM strategy across the connected customer journey, from brand consideration and lead generation to end-to-end lifecycle CRM, web experience, and retail activations.

You will work closely in partnership with our data strategy team, using the insight from our access to customer data to shape strategy and drive performance.   

You'll be involved from brief through to delivery, helping shape the strategic direction, inspire creative thinking and make sure the work remains rooted in a clear understanding of the customer and the client's commercial objectives.

You'll work across multiple stakeholders and levels of seniority, so being able to adapt your approach, communicate clearly and build strong relationships will be just as important as the quality of your strategic thinking.

There will also be opportunities to contribute to wider strategic projects and new business, giving you the chance to bring your perspective to different challenges and clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the strategic direction across projects, from understanding the brief through to creative development, client sell-in and measuring effectiveness.
  • Turn business, customer, cultural and behavioural information into clear, actionable insights.
  • Write compelling strategic and creative briefs that give creative teams a clear direction and space to do their best work across CRM, digital, social, and dealership assets.
  • Drive the CRM comms strategy across the end ot end custome journey including automated/triggered reminders, seasonal promotional campaigns, and ad-hoc owner messaging.
  • Work closely with Client Services, Creative, Data and Media partners to develop connected, effective solutions.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients and become a confident and credible strategic partner.
  • Present and sell strategic thinking clearly to clients and internal stakeholders at different levels.
  • Use data, research and customer understanding to inform strategic recommendations and strengthen the work.
  • Ensure strategic thinking remains connected to the client's commercial objectives and desired outcomes.
  • Challenge briefs and thinking constructively when there is an opportunity to make the work better.
  • Contribute to pitches, quarterly thought leadership, proactive thinking and opportunities to grow existing and new client relationships.
  • Support and develop more junior members of the strategy team, sharing knowledge and helping raise the quality of strategic output.
  • Bring curiosity and new thinking into the team, keeping up with changes in culture, technology, customer behaviour and the wider industry.

Who You Are

  • Strategically strong: You can get to the heart of a problem, identify what really matters and turn it into a clear point of view.
  • Commercially minded: You understand how strategic thinking connects to client business objectives, funnel performance, lead generation, and long-term customer retention.
  • Confident but collaborative: You're comfortable leading a conversation and challenging a client or colleague, but you're equally happy listening and adapting your thinking.
  • A strong communicator: You can make complex thinking feel simple, whether you're presenting to a senior client or briefing a creative team.
  • Customer curious: You genuinely want to understand what makes people tick and how their behaviours, needs and motivations can influence the work.
  • Low ego: You care more about getting to the right answer than getting credit for having it. You enjoy working with different people and bringing the best out of those around you.
  • Adaptable: You can fluidly navigate different briefs, from building our high-level brand frameworks and strategy houses to detailed CRM journeys, content strategies, and retail activation briefs.
  • sight of the strategic objective.
  • Culturally & Technologically curious: You're interested in what's happening in the world and know how to turn those observations into useful strategic thinking. You stay ahead of emerging tech and media trends - including AI, LLMs, and GEO and know how to turn those insights into useful strategy.
  • A team player: You enjoy working alongside Client Services, Creative and other disciplines and understand that the best work rarely comes from one person working alone.

What You'll Need

  • Proven experience working as a CRM Strategist within an agency environment (automotive is a strong advantage).
  • Connected customer journey strategic experience spanning brand consideration, lead generation (e.g., test drives), and post-purchase CRM/servicing retention.
  • Experience developing strategic thinking from brief through to creative development, delivery, and performance evaluation.
  • A passion for creativity, we want you to do your best creative work at VML
  • Strong understanding of customer behavior, journey mapping, CRM/lifecycle comms, and digital ecosystems (web, search, social, dealership touchpoints).
  • Confidence presenting strategic thinking and recommendations to clients.
  • The ability to interpret data and research and turn it into meaningful insight.
  • Experience contributing to pitches and/or proactive strategic projects would be beneficial.
  • Experience supporting or mentoring junior team members would be advantageous.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic thinking that is clear, ambitious and rooted in genuine customer and business insight.
  • Clients who see you as a trusted strategic partner and value your perspective.
  • Creative teams who feel inspired and clear on the opportunity you're giving them.
  • Strong collaboration across Strategy, Creative, Client Services and specialist teams.
  • Strategic recommendations that contribute to meaningful client and business outcomes.
  • A positive impact on the development and quality of the wider strategy team.
  • The ability to bring clarity and momentum to complex challenges.

What's in It for You?

  • The opportunity to work on high-profile clients and commercially meaningful challenges.
  • The chance to work alongside talented people across Strategy, Creative, Client Services and specialist disciplines.
  • A genuinely collaborative environment where different perspectives are encouraged.
  • Opportunities to work across a broad range of strategic challenges and develop your experience.

raw.title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
raw.description:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Care Expert – Medizincontrolling & Pflegedokumentation Krankenhaus (m/w/d)
description: 🎤 WARUM voize? WEIL ES UM MEHR GEHT ALS EINEN JOB. Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren. Das wollen wir ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik, wir verstärken ihre Wirkung. Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag. Wir verbinden erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Nutzen. Und jetzt suchen wir dich. 💡 DEINE MISSION Im Krankenhaus dokumentieren Pflegekräfte mit voize direkt am Bett. Die freigegebenen Einträge landen strukturiert im KIS, über unsere Integration mit ORBIS U von Dedalus. Damit ist Pflegedokumentation nicht nur Grundlage guter Pflege, sondern auch Grundlage für Kodierung, Abrechnung und MD-Prüfungen. Abgerechnet werden kann nur, was belegt ist. Genau hier brauchen wir deinen Blick aus dem Medizincontrolling. Als Care Expert berätst du Kliniken, wie ihre Pflegedokumentation aufgebaut sein muss, damit erbrachte Leistungen vollständig und prüfsicher in der Akte stehen. Mit den strengeren MD-Prüfquoten ab 2027 wird das für viele Häuser zur wirtschaftlichen Frage. Du arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit Medizincontrolling, Pflegedirektion, Stationsleitungen und Klinik-IT. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich darin, dass Pflegekräfte Zeit gewinnen und die Dokumentation zugleich den Anforderungen von Kodierung und Prüfung standhält. 🚀 DEIN ALLTAG Dokumentation verstehen, bevor es zählt: Vor dem Go-live analysierst du mit Medizincontrolling, Pflege und Klinik-IT, wie die Pflegedokumentation im KIS aufgebaut ist, von Assessments wie ePA-AC und Barthel über LEP-Maßnahmen bis zu Vitalwerten, Bilanzierung und Wunddokumentation. Die Erlös- und Prüfperspektive einbringen: Du zeigst, welche pflegerischen Inhalte für die Rechtfertigung der Verweildauer, Nebendiagnosen, Komplexbehandlungen wie die geriatrische frührehabilitative Komplexbehandlung und die MD-Prüfung relevant sind, und wo heute Informationen auf dem Weg in die Akte verloren gehen. Zwischen Pflege, Medizincontrolling und System übersetzen: Anforderungen aus Kodierrichtlinien und Prüfverfahren machst du für Pflegeteams greifbar, und Pflegealltag für das Medizincontrolling. Wirkung sichtbar machen: Gemeinsam mit den Kliniken legst du fest, woran sich Dokumentationsqualität messen lässt, und unterstützt bei ROI-Workshops mit Geschäftsführung und Medizincontrolling. Sauber einordnen: Läuft etwas nicht wie erwartet, findest du heraus, ob es an der KIS-Konfiguration, am Prozess auf Station oder am Produkt liegt. Deine Einschätzung geht klar an Customer Success, Support und Product, und du bringst die Sicht des Medizincontrollings in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Krankenhaus-Produkts ein. Kliniken begleiten: Remote und bei Bedarf vor Ort begleitest du Einführungen über den Go-live hinaus, eng abgestimmt mit dem zuständigen Customer Success Manager. Wissen aufbauen, das skaliert: Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst du Playbooks, Checklisten und interne Enablements für den Krankenhausbereich, etwa zu DRG-Grundlagen und MD-Prüfungen für unsere Kolleg:innen. 🤝 DEIN PROFIL Du hast mindestens eine Weiterbildung zur Medizinischen Kodierfachkraft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und Praxis im Medizincontrolling eines Krankenhauses. Erfahrung als Medizincontroller:in ist ein großes Plus. Du bist sicher im aG-DRG-System, in ICD-10-GM, OPS und den Deutschen Kodierrichtlinien und kennst die Abläufe rund um MD-Prüfungen und die Prüfverfahrensvereinbarung aus eigener Fallbearbeitung. Idealerweise bringst du einen pflegerischen Grundberuf mit, etwa in der Gesundheits- und Krankenpflege, und weißt, wie Dokumentation auf Station wirklich entsteht. Du hast mit einem KIS gearbeitet, am liebsten mit ORBIS von Dedalus. Pflegerische Assessments und Leistungserfassung wie ePA-AC oder LEP sind dir vertraut oder du arbeitest dich schnell ein. Systeme sind für dich Werkzeug, kein Hindernis. Du denkst in Abhängigkeiten und Ursachen und bleibst dran, bis du verstehst, warum etwas so ist. Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, einer Pflegedirektion genauso wie einer Pflegekraft im Spätdienst oder der Geschäftsführung einer Klinik. Du arbeitest gern beratend und strukturiert. Du gibst klare Empfehlungen und vertrittst sie auch. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Auf Englisch solltest du dich sicher verständigen können, weil ein Teil der internen Zusammenarbeit auf Englisch läuft. Du bist gern bei unseren Kunden. Termine vor Ort gehören regelmäßig dazu, der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft remote. 🌱 GEMEINSAM WACHSEN – DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI voize Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Startup. Du übernimmst neue Themen, wächst schnell und bewirkst etwas, das Pflegekräften mehr Zeit für die Menschen gibt. Du gestaltest mit: Unser Krankenhausbereich wächst gerade, und du prägst, wie wir Kliniken fachlich begleiten. Wir leben eine offene, kollaborative Kultur mit regelmäßigen Team-Events, ob du aus unserem Berliner Office arbeitest oder remote aus Deutschland. Mit Stock Options wirst du Teil unseres Erfolgs. 30 Urlaubstage plus dein Geburtstag frei, Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, regelmäßige Company-Offsites sowie Zugang zu Lernplattformen wie Blinkist und Audible. Du entscheidest, wann du am besten arbeitest: flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein gutes Hybrid-Setup. ✨ LUST AUF EIN GESPRÄCH? JETZT BEWERBEN. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen, ganz gleich, wer du bist und welchen Hintergrund du mitbringst. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️ Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. raw.description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

The Role

The goal of this role is pipeline revenue, driven through relationships. The Partner BDM is where the global partnership strategy meets the market, and you own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed that number. Every relationship, every lead, every partner conversation in your territory goes through you. You execute all three partnership pillars locally — integration depth, reseller acquisition, and long tail activation — and you feed the national programs run by Isabel and the Director of Reseller Partnerships with the contacts, intelligence, and HubSpot discipline that makes those programs possible.

This role also carries a global partner management component. In addition to your regional territory, you will be assigned one or two global partner accounts — relationships that span multiple BDM regions and require a consistent strategic, commercial presence above the regional level. You will manage these accounts directly, briefing with the Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior contact touchpoint and feeding back the account intelligence that informs RPG's global partner strategy.

The BDM is not a lone hunter. You are supported by intelligence briefs from the Director of Partnership Strategy, onboarding infrastructure from the Partner Operation and Enablement Manager, co-sell support from the Director of Channel Growth Reseller, and global account context from the Global Partner Marketing Manager. The discipline of using those inputs — requesting briefs before first calls, completing HubSpot fields that trigger Isabel's onboarding, registering every lead in Introw on the day — is what makes the whole system work.

Your Role

Pipeline and revenue ownership — your region

  • Own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed this number, not just a contributor to it

  • Build and maintain a consistent bottoms-up pipeline plan, built up against your region's targets and TAM — showing exactly how your book of business adds up to your target, by partner type and by deal stage

  • Forecast monthly, ahead of the full-team KPR review — reforecasting pipeline and revenue coverage against target, reconciling to the latest refreshed regional targets/TAM where these have moved, so gaps are visible early and plans can be adjusted before target dates, not after

Regional partner development — all partner types

  • Build and manage the full partner portfolio in your territory: integration partners, resellers, consultants, hotel management companies, and referral partners

  • Source new reseller and consultant contacts in your region — using the Ideal Reseller Partner Profile as the qualification standard

  • Execute the partner conversation playbook for each contact type: open with the partner intelligence brief, use the CS manager and KAM conversation guides for integration partners, apply the reseller screening framework for agency contacts

  • Request a partner intelligence brief from the Director Channel Growth - Integration before every first partner outreach — no first conversation without a brief

  • Complete the 4 mandatory HubSpot fields (deal stage, partner fields, agreement file, partnership type) before advancing any deal past the signed stage — this triggers Isabel's onboarding program

  • Register every qualified lead in Introw on the day it is received, tagged by source type (integration referral / reseller / consultant / reactivated dormant)

Global Partner Account Management

  • Own one or two assigned global partner accounts — relationships where the partner operates across multiple BDM territories and requires consistent commercial management above the regional level

  • Build the regional strategy for each assigned global account that generates pipeline — not just relationship maintenance; you are responsible for identifying where the pipeline comes from in your territory and driving it

  • Coordinate with Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior touchpoint at a global partner account — global commercial context will be provided; you provide the regional relationship intelligence

  • Maintain the account relationship at the appropriate contact levels (sales, CS, KAM, implementation) — applying the multi-level engagement model from the Partner Activation Playbook

  • Feed the Head of Global Partnerships and the Global Partner Marketing Manager with global account intelligence after every significant touchpoint — health signals, competitive intelligence, co-marketing opportunities, and any escalation requirements

  • Support the coordination of co-marketing and QBR activity with the global partner where it involves your region

Long Tail Activation — Regional subset

  • Own your regional subset of the 272 dormant signed partners — the Director Channel Growth - Reseller & Consultant,provides the segmented list, you own the outreach

  • Execute the tiered re-engagement approach: Tier 1 (60–90 days dormant) with a personalized message within the first week of assignment; Tier 2 with re-qualification before any effort; Tier 3 with a single attempt then escalation to Isabel to archive

  • Report progress on your regional dormant subset to Isabel weekly during the H2 activation sprint

Market intelligence and HubSpot discipline

  • Surface partner contacts and market intelligence to the Reseller PM in the bi-weekly regional intel exchange — which reseller types are gaining traction, which are declining, what competitive signals are emerging

  • Flag any integration partner conversation where an all-in-one competitive angle appears — the Strategy Manager updates the competitive library with field intelligence

  • Maintain HubSpot contact and deal records at the expected quality standard — the data in HubSpot is what the whole team uses to run the business; poor data quality breaks Isabel's onboarding, Isabel's dormancy tracking, and Introw attribution simultaneously

  • Participate in the monthly full-team KPR review — presenting your regional lead pipeline and flagging any structural blockers

Your Profile

  • 2+ years in a B2B business development, partnerships, or commercial account management role — ideally in SaaS, hospitality technology, or a related field

  • Demonstrates advanced proficiency in German (C2 level), with excellent command of both

  • Track record of building relationships and generating pipeline from scratch in a defined territory — not managing inbound, but generating outbound

  • Comfortable operating across multiple partner types and conversation styles in a single week — integration partnership conversations require a different approach than reseller qualification

  • HubSpot or CRM discipline — this is a non-negotiable requirement; the quality of your data determines the quality of the team's output

  • Based in the target territory — regional credibility and proximity to local partners is part of the role

Nice to Have

  • Existing network in the hotel technology ecosystem (PMS, channel manager, consultants, or revenue management) in the relevant territory

  • Experience managing global or multi-territory accounts in addition to a local territory portfolio

  • Familiarity with Introw, PartnerStack, Reditus, or similar partner and commission tracking platforms

  • Revenue management or hospitality operations background — understanding how an independent hotel owner thinks is a genuine advantage in partner conversations

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

title: Principal Engineer - Facades / External Walls
description:
Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.

Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. 

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Job Overview

Role can be based in any of our UK offices.

Jensen Hughes is a company fiercely committed to our purpose, our clients, and each other. Every single member of our team is essential to our success. Due to the continued growth and success of our External Walls and Facades team, we have an exciting opportunity for a Principal Engineer to join our market leading UK team.

As a Principal Engineer, you will provide advanced technical delivery and project leadership across façade engineering and external wall fire consultancy services, you will be responsible for exercising independent engineering judgement on complex projects, leading technical workstreams, and ensuring that deliverables are technically robust, proportionate, and defensible. You will be a senior technical contributor within project teams, support quality assurance and peer review processes, mentor developing engineers, and contribute to maintaining Jensen Hughes’ reputation for high-quality, risk-based advice.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical delivery on façade and external wall projects of moderate to high complexity.
  • Exercise independent engineering judgement in relation to façade systems, fire performance, remediation strategies, and compliance pathways.
  • Prepare and oversee the preparation of external wall fire assessment reports (e.g. PAS 9980 appraisals), façade engineering reports, and technical notes.
  • Review façade build-ups, materials, fire stopping provisions, cavity barriers, and remediation proposals.
  • Assess test evidence, classification reports, product certifications, and desktop studies.
  • Identify technical risks and develop proportionate mitigation strategies.
  • Act as day-to-day technical lead on allocated projects.
  • Lead technical discussions with clients, architects, contractors, and multidisciplinary design teams.
  • Provide clear, structured technical advice aligned with legislation, statutory guidance, and industry standards.

If successful, here is what we will expect from you:

  • Operate with increasing independence in technical judgement.
  • Demonstrate commercial awareness in project delivery.
  • Show readiness to transition toward Associate-level leadership responsibilities.
  • Build recognised technical credibility internally and externally.
  • Contribute to strengthening Jensen Hughes’ façade and external wall capability.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Degree qualified in Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent demonstrable experience).
  • Chartered or actively working towards chartership (strongly preferred).
  • Significant experience in façade engineering and/or external wall fire consultancy.
  • Strong understanding of façade systems, construction methods, and performance requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams independently.
  • Experience in preparing and reviewing PAS 9980 appraisals or similar risk-based assessments.
  • Strong report writing capability and structured technical reasoning.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers.
  • Clear communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 

Our People Are Our Greatest Asset

At Jensen Hughes, we know that our people are the foundation of our success. To attract and retain the best talent, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, work-life balance, and professional growth.

Our UK and Ireland Benefits Include:

  • Private medical insurance
  • 33 days paid time off with an additional day after 3 years
  • Industry-leading contributory pension scheme
  • 4 x life assurance
  • Income protection scheme
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Employee assistance programme
  • Enhanced parental-related pay
  • Recognition and reward programmes to celebrate team efforts
  • Access to extensive technical training and resources

Supporting Your Work-Life Balance

We understand the importance of flexibility and balance. We're happy to discuss hybrid, part-time, and flexible working arrangements to suit both you and the business. We also offer:

  • Flexible working hours and patterns including early Friday finish
  • Flexible holiday use over Christmas/New Year
  • Enhanced holiday entitlement after three years
  • The option to carry over up to five unused holiday days into the next year

A Commitment to Continuous Improvement

Our benefits represent a meaningful investment in both our people and the future of Jensen Hughes. We regularly review our benefits programme to ensure it aligns with statutory requirements, market trends, and the needs of our team. Any modifications will be carefully considered to support our employees and the company’s long-term goals.

 

#LI-SG1 #LI-hybrid

At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.  We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.  Please click here to review.

About the role

Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise.
You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem.
This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you.
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one.

What you would do

Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows.

  • Conduct hands-on penetration testing and threat modeling across our web application, APIs, control plane, and cloud environments.

  • Manage end-to-end vulnerability tracking across our codebases, software dependencies (SCA), container images, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Proactively fix security flaws by writing patches, submitting Pull Requests (PRs), or collaborating directly with product teams to guide remediation.

  • Audit and harden our cloud infrastructure (GCP, Kubernetes clusters, and networking configurations) against external and internal threats.

  • Automate security tooling into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, dependency scanners) to catch CVEs before code reaches production.

  • Perform security code reviews and evaluate third-party dependencies, open-source integrations, and supply-chain risks.

  • Lead incident response efforts and establish continuous monitoring, detection, and mitigation strategies.

  • Own our public security posture as an open-source project: vulnerability disclosure process, CVE handling, security advisories, and the trust model of our plugin ecosystem.

Our Tech Stack

  • Security & Vulnerability Tools: Trivy, GitHub Security / Dependabot, Elastic Security

  • Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform

  • Cloud: GCP

  • Programming language: Java, Typescript, Javascript

  • Datastore: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch

  • Queuing: Redis, Kafka, AMQP

  • Monitoring & Logs: ELK, Prometheus, Grafana

  • Deployment & Repository: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Product Security, DevSecOps, or a combined Offensive/Defensive role.

  • Prior experience in cross-functional automation or rapid-response task force environments.
  • Strong operational mindset, quick decision-making, and project management abilities.

We are seeking a (Senior) Data Scientist (all genders) to join a dynamic team of five within our DATA department. You'll dive into diverse challenges including training and deploying machine learning models, developing Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, and statistical modeling. Your Role

  • Employ statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms for regression, classification, and clustering (e.g., Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, Hierarchical Clustering, ensemble methods).
  • Develop and productionalize Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions alongside modern NLP techniques using transformer architectures (e.g., BERT, GPT).
  • Utilize time-series forecasting methods (e.g., ARIMA, LSTM, DeepAR, Prophet) for predictive modeling.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA), advanced feature engineering, and dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE).
  • Develop and implement deep learning models in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras while leveraging transfer learning strategies.
  • Showcase your skills across key e-commerce data science use cases including demand forecasting, churn and CLTV modeling, pricing, customer segmentation, recommender systems, and personalization.
  • Handle large-scale datasets using distributed computing frameworks (Apache Spark) on a tech stack comprising Python (PySpark, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, LightGBM), SQL, Databricks (Data Lakehouse & ML platform), AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, SageMaker, Bedrock), GitHub, and AI-augmented tools (Claude, Copilot) while collaborating directly to proactively address stakeholder business needs.

Your Profile

  • Bring a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in developing and deploying machine learning solutions for real-world business problems.
  • Demonstrate background exposure to e-commerce (ideal), fintech, or fast-paced agency environments.
  • Demonstrate hands-on experience with Databricks as a Data & AI platform (required) alongside cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Prove hands-on experience in building, productionalizing, and deploying Generative AI or Agentic AI solutions.
  • Apply hands-on experience with MLOps practices and tools (required) for end-to-end model lifecycle management.
  • Possess a strong grasp of core data science principles to select the most appropriate techniques, combined with advanced proficiency in SQL, Python (PySpark, scikit-learn, NumPy, matplotlib, pandas), and AI-augmented development tools (Claude, Copilot).
  • Communicate exceptionally in English (written and verbal) to articulate complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders, driving projects with full end-to-end ownership as a collaborative team player.

What We Offer

  • Our employees matter to us: We offer you a permanent contract and cover the costs for your Deutschland ticket.
  • Work-life balance: 29 vacation days plus additional days off on the 24th and 31st December, flexible working hours, up to three days of working from home per week, working abroad options, paid sabbatical.
  • flaconi Academy: Actively shape your own career path by taking advantage of our internal and external training opportunities.
  • We care about your well being: We want to support you also during difficult times. For this, we offer you and your close relatives counseling sessions with mental health professionals.

  • Thinking about tomorrow together: flaconi subsidizes your savings contribution to the company pension scheme with an additional 20%.
  • A comfortable working space with everything you need: High end technical equipment, fruits and drinks, no dress code and dogs are welcome in our office!
  • Other perks: Great discounts in our online shop as well with our partner companies, cool team events & company parties!

title: Stage - Project Manager & Automation (F/H) - Paris
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Horizon Trading Solutions est une FinTech internationale indépendante, spécialisée dans les technologies de trading électronique multi-actifs depuis plus de 20 ans. Avec environ 160 collaborateurs répartis entre Paris, Rennes, Nantes, Montréal, Dubaï, Hong Kong, Bangkok et Singapour, nous accompagnons les institutions financières dans l'optimisation de leurs activités de trading grâce à des solutions technologiques innovantes.

Certifiée B Corp, Horizon s'engage en faveur d'une innovation responsable et a été récompensée à plusieurs reprises pour ses solutions, notamment avec le prix Best Sell-Side OMS 2025.

Le poste

Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire en automatisation et gestion de projet pour rejoindre notre équipe Client Delivery Management (CDM), dans le cadre d'un stage de 6 mois, avec un démarrage possible entre février et avril 2027.

Notre équipe CDM accompagne nos clients dans le déploiement, la personnalisation et l'évolution de notre plateforme de trading, de la connectivité API à la configuration des workflows de trading.

Dans une démarche d'amélioration continue, nous avons récemment déployé Rocketlane, une plateforme dédiée à la gestion de projets et à l'onboarding client.

Votre mission sera de développer des solutions d'automatisation, d'optimiser les processus existants et d'intégrer Rocketlane à nos outils internes, afin de simplifier le quotidien de nos chefs de projet, de fiabiliser le suivi des activités et de réduire les tâches répétitives.

Ce stage vous permettra d'évoluer à l'intersection de la technologie, de la gestion de projet et des marchés financiers, en participant à des projets concrets dans un environnement international.

Vos missions

  • Analyse et optimisation des processus : Étudier l'utilisation actuelle de Rocketlane et identifier les tâches manuelles pouvant être automatisées : création de projets à partir de modèles, relances, mises à jour de statuts et reporting.

  • Développement et automatisation : Concevoir et développer des scripts et des automatisations, notamment en Python, en exploitant les API et les webhooks de Rocketlane.

  • Intégration des outils : Améliorer l'interconnexion entre Rocketlane et nos outils internes (ticketing, support, documentation, annuaires clients) afin de limiter les doubles saisies et de fluidifier le partage d'informations.

  • Suivi et reporting : Contribuer à la création et à l'amélioration de tableaux de bord, d'indicateurs de performance et d'outils de suivi des projets.

  • Participation aux projets clients : Prendre part à des projets d'onboarding réels pour comprendre les besoins opérationnels, notamment les tests de connexion, la configuration des workflows de trading et la documentation.

  • Collaboration transverse : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Client Delivery, Développement, Support et Produit pour comprendre leurs besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées.

Purpose and objectives of the role
An Architect acts under supervision regarding architectural methods and complexities and is responsible for the development and design of complex architectural projects. In this position you may act a member of a team supporting the lead architect.

This position contributes to the finished packages, specifications, approval of materials/products and development of construction packages. The Architect must be able to apply sound and diverse knowledge of architecture principles and practices in a broad array of assignments.
