title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Ceph Storage
description:
Location Details: 

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.  

Join Our Team…

GoDaddy's Global Storage Engineering team operates one of the largest Ceph environments in the industry, powering the object, block, and file storage platforms that underpin hosting, applications, internal infrastructure, and next-generation AI/HPC workloads. If you're passionate about distributed systems, large-scale storage architecture, and solving complex reliability challenges, you'll work on infrastructure that few engineers ever experience. 

At GoDaddy, Ceph isn't a side project — it's a critical platform. Our environment spans 80+ production clusters, 20,000+ OSDs, and approximately 300 PB of raw storage capacity, supporting tens of billions of objects across multiple continents. The scale demands deep technical expertise in storage architecture, automation, observability, and performance engineering. 

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you'll be a key technical owner of the platform, responsible for maintaining reliability, driving operational excellence, and influencing the future evolution of our storage ecosystem. You'll tackle challenging production problems, develop automation that operates at massive scale, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with some of the industry's most experienced Ceph engineers. This is an opportunity to have direct impact on a storage platform that serves millions of customers worldwide. 

What You'll Get to Do…

  • Own the reliability, performance, scalability, and capacity of large-scale production Ceph environments supporting object, block, and file storage workloads (RADOS, RGW, RBD, CephFS). 
  • Diagnose and resolve complex distributed systems issues including recovery/backfill events, OSD instability, PG imbalance, storage latency, and RGW performance bottlenecks. 
  • Design and build automation using Python, Shell, SaltStack, and Ansible to reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience at scale. 
  • Define and improve observability for the storage platform through SLIs, SLOs, PromQL, LogQL, Grafana dashboards, and proactive alerting strategies. 
  • Lead storage lifecycle initiatives including cluster expansions, hardware refreshes, software upgrades, OpenStack integrations, and large-scale migration projects. 

Your Experience Should Include…

  • 5+ years operating large-scale Linux infrastructure with significant experience supporting distributed storage systems in production environments. 
  • 2+ years hands-on Ceph administration including OSD, MON, MDS, and RGW operations, CRUSH map management, pool design, placement groups, and performance troubleshooting. 
  • Strong understanding of Linux internals, storage architecture, networking, filesystems, block devices, and performance analysis under production workloads. 
  • Experience developing operational automation and tooling with Python, Shell, and configuration management platforms such as Ansible, SaltStack, Puppet, or Chef. 
  • Proven incident response expertise, including production troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, postmortem creation, and implementation of durable corrective actions. 

You Might Also Have…

  • Advanced Ceph expertise across RGW Multisite, CephFS, RBD Mirroring, erasure coding, and large-scale cluster design. 
  • Experience integrating storage platforms with OpenStack (Cinder, Nova, Neutron, Swift) or Kubernetes storage technologies (CSI, StorageClasses, Rook). 
  • Familiarity with modern observability platforms including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Grafana, and enterprise monitoring architectures. 
  • Experience planning and executing petabyte-scale storage migrations, capacity expansion programs, and storage hardware lifecycle management. 
  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure or storage projects and a passion for advancing distributed systems technologies. 

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

We've got your back... description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do

  • Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.
  • Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.
  • Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.
  • Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.
  • Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.
  • Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.
  • Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.
  • Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.
  • As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

  • A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.
  • 4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.
  • Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.
  • A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.
  • Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.
  • Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.
  • A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.
  • Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).
  • A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.
  • Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.

Nice to have:

  • Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.
  • Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.
  • Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.
  • GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: QA Director
description:
Scopely is looking for a QA Director to join our Stumble Guys team in our Barcelona or Dundee hubs, working in a hybrid mode 3 days from the hub.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 

Stumble Guys is a global sensation, with millions of fans joining the party every single day and with the ambition of becoming nothing less than a beloved franchise to be played for many years to come.

What You Will Do 

You will collaborate and coordinate with peers, senior management and external partners, to ensure operations are aligned with the departmental mission, values, and long-term strategic goals as well as ensuring continued service improvements are implemented throughout the world on behalf of Scopely QA & Deployment. 

You will help shape the future on how we continue to iterate and evolve our products at a high level, while ensuring our products delight our players release after release. Day to day responsibilities may include:

  • Lead an ambitious Mobile and Console QA & Deployment Program involving multiple disciplines, including Functionality QA, Dev QA, Live-Ops QA, Build Distribution and Submissions across all platforms
  • Manage and provide leadership, technical expertise and career development for multiple QA & Deployment Project Owners; support the skillset growth across the QA & Deployment crafts, leading to higher value individual contributors and managers
  • Build on existing team metrics for measurement of quality and operational excellence and a consistent, regular process for assessment and improvements
  • Manage day-to-day relationships with external QA vendors, aligning priorities, capacity and deliverables with project needs; assess vendor performance against agreed quality and delivery targets and drive improvement actions
  • Be an advocate and spokesperson for Automation Engineering efforts and AI implementation into QA pipelines. Clearly communicate issues, risks, concerns, and successes to stakeholders, partners, and executives
  • Establish and maintain strong communication with cross-functional teams across all disciplines for both internal and external development, QA and Localization partners
  • Work with the Deployment Project Managers and Dev QA teams to create efficient plans, assignments, and schedules for associated quality functions
  • Continually improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness of the QA & Deployment effort by assessing current practices and incorporating new strategies
  • Be the internal advocate and spokesperson for all things QA & Deployment. Clearly communicate issues, risks, concerns, and successes to stakeholders
  • Hold fellow leaders accountable for including quality as an essential factor in product development
  • Lead regular performance assessments of QA & Deployment Project Owners and their teams, using clear objectives, quality metrics and stakeholder feedback to guide coaching, development and performance improvement.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10 + years as a quality assurance professional
  • 6 + years management experience in leading a team through a full game cycle
  • Excellent written/verbal communication in English
  • Experience in building and managing a QA organization that is responsible for end-to-end validation for a critical system or application
  • Demonstrated experience managing external QA vendors, including setting delivery expectations, assessing performance and driving service improvements, alongside a strong understanding of Dev QA and external testing strategies.
  • Experience working with remote teams and with a cross functional team that is distributed around the globe
  • Experience and ease in interfacing with Senior Management, working to develop and maintain strong, effective relationships across the organization
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to multitask under pressure of hard deadlines
  • Demonstrated experience managing bug defect solutions & creating test plans
  • Strong understanding of software development (SDLC) practices & nomenclature, quality assurance techniques, frameworks and methodologies
  • Flexible and dynamic – quickly adapt to changing needs of the business
  • Good understanding of the current and evolving landscape of AI-powered testing tools, and experience driving the transition from manual testing approaches to AI-native.
  • Business awareness - the ability to view situations from a business perspective
  • Proficient with setting up and navigating through bug database management, test case management tools, Google Docs, Google Sheets/Excel, and a build distribution management system (AppLivery), JIRA
  • Mobile Freemium/F2P gaming experience

Bonus Points 

  • Experience with Console and PC deployment & compliance.
  • Any experience with Localization, LQA, build distribution and submissions 

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

  • Responsable du go-to-market conjoint avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques : co-construction des offres, des plans d’affaires et de la démarche de co-selling autour de nos capabilities auprès de clients et prospects,

Cette hybridation est la clé du succès : être à la fois moteur du business généré via l’écosystème partenaires et garant de la capacité des équipes à délivrer avec ces technologies.

Dimension Business :

  • Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market et de marketing partenaires de WPP Enterprise Solutions avec ses partenaires technologiques stratégiques, afin de maximiser la valeur, la différenciation et le pipeline générés par l’écosystème,

  • Sécurise et défend les intérêts économique et contractuel de WPP Enterprise Solutions dans le cadre des accords de partenariat (referral, reselling, MDF, niveaux de partenariat),
  • Pilote le niveau de préférence et de mindshare de nos partenaires à notre égard : positionne WPP Enterprise Solutions comme partenaire de référence dans leur écosystème, fait progresser notre niveau de partenariat et suit la performance des objectifs conjoints,
  • Contribue au thought leadership de WPP Enterprise Solutions sur les enjeux d’écosystème et de plateformes (IA, data, commerce, CX), via des prises de parole conjointes valorisant nos réussites dans une logique de ROI business,
  • Construit et fait vivre un patrimoine de connaissances sur l’écosystème technologique (roadmaps produits, niveaux et programmes de partenariat, dispositifs de financement) afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,
  • Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence du modèle partenaires en interne, en particulier auprès des communautés commerciale et managériale, pour l’inspirer et développer son réflexe écosystème.

Dimension Enablement & Delivery :

  • Travaille de concert avec le CTO, à qui revient la responsabilité de l’enablement, des certifications et de la montée en compétences des équipes sur les plateformes partenaires ; il s’assure que ces chantiers progressent au rythme des priorités business et des engagements pris auprès des partenaires,
  • Veille à la disponibilité et à la capitalisation des assets conjoints (cas clients, références, supports de co-vente) et au partage des retours d’expérience.

Profil recherché

Vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d’expérience, dont une expérience significative en alliances / partenariats technologiques, channel ou business development – idéalement acquise en cabinet de conseil, ESN, agence ou chez un éditeur / hyperscaler.

Notre croissance reposant sur un écosystème de partenaires technologiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de co-selling, de co-marketing et de joint business planning.

Vous pouvez justifier de contributions ou de succès significatifs dans le cadre d’initiatives partenaires ou de développement business, au-delà d’en comprendre la logique ou les bonnes pratiques.

Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité, tant avec les équipes partenaires (alliance managers, channel, avant-vente) qu’avec les décideurs internes (Directions commerciales, Business Units, Marketing), fait de vous un orchestrateur d’écosystème performant, du sourcing d’opportunités à la conclusion de deals conjoints équilibrant les intérêts du partenaire, du client et de WPP Enterprise Solutions.

Les enjeux des plateformes technologiques et de l’écosystème IA / data / commerce vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en interne comme auprès des partenaires.

Votre rigueur et votre curiosité font de vous un acteur à la fois à l’aise dans la logique de développement business sur des clients existants que sur de la conquête opportuniste, ou en relai d’un partenaire.

La maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est indispensable : vous adressez des partenaires et des interlocuteurs internationaux de manière totalement autonome.

Intégrer WPP Enterprise Solutions, c’est choisir d’évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, humain et innovant, propice au développement de chacun, à la réalisation de missions enrichissantes et aux évolutions de carrière. title: System Test Automation Engineer
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Verification and Release Test Team Wayve’s Verification and Release Test team sits at the intersection of hardware, embedded software and machine learning models. Our testing spans component, system and vehicle levels, and we build novel test automation in-house to identify issues earlier in development. We pride ourselves on finding the most efficient and effective ways to deliver the most valuable results for the company. As a System Test Engineer, HIL, you’ll build robust, reusable automation and work across engineering disciplines to improve coverage, reliability and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system, including sensing and model-behaviour testing, as Wayve and your experience evolve. 🧠 Your day-to-day Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration and system levels, working across software and hardware boundaries. Lead root-cause investigations for failures identified during test campaigns, collaborating with hardware, software, infrastructure and DevOps teams to resolve issues. Analyse test results, uncover software and hardware bugs, and report findings through Jira with clear evidence to support debugging. Optimise Buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable and repeatable execution. Review, create and follow risk assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Independently owning the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack, steadily raising the bar on coverage, reliability and traceability. Building open-loop and closed-loop hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) replay tests, alongside reliability and fault-injection tests, to support verification, release and debugging. Automating HIL test setups and improving test infrastructure to expand coverage, make failures easier to trace and strengthen compliance reporting. Integrating requirements, coverage and compliance workflows, including Jama, MC/DC coverage analysis and MISRA checks, and managing test artefacts through Artifactory and Azure. Developing traceability dashboards and defining KPIs and quality metrics that support data-driven validation and release decisions. 🙌 You should apply if: You have hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software or mechatronic systems, with a track record of independently delivering test automation. You’re highly proficient in Python and have experience developing automation test frameworks using pytest. You’ve worked with HIL testing and tooling, including interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet or GMSL, and tools from dSPACE, Vector, Xylon or similar providers. You understand open-loop and closed-loop HIL replay testing using dSPACE or other emulators. You’re familiar with automotive safety and process standards, including ISO 26262, ASPICE and SOTIF, and have experience integrating requirements and test-management tools such as Jama and Xray. You’re proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling, such as GitLab CI, Buildkite and Bazel. You have experience developing or testing automotive software at embedded and system levels, including hardware/software interactions and interface-level testing, and have worked with L2+ hands-off, L3 or L4 automated driving systems. You have knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols such as Euro NCAP, including AEB and LSS/LKA scenarios; DCAS regulatory testing under UN R171; and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards, including ISO/SAE 21434 and UN R155. You’ve worked with test automation dashboards, logging and reporting infrastructure, using tools such as Grafana, Looker, Datadog and Jira. You’re a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement who communicates clearly and works effectively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps and product teams. Ideally, you’ve contributed to improvements in test methods, safety procedures or operational efficiency, and are familiar with data management and version control tools such as Git. Experience using agentic AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code to accelerate and improve test development, debugging and automation workflows would also be valuable. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes) Competency Interviews (Programming and hiring manager interview; 1 hour 45 minutes total) Deep-dive technical interviews (Cross-functional, system design; 1 hour 45 minutes total) Final interview : mission & values alignment (45 minutes). We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.   • You’re highly proficient in Python and have experience developing automation test frameworks using pytest.

  • You’ve worked with HIL testing and tooling, including interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet or GMSL, and tools from dSPACE, Vector, Xylon or similar providers.

  • You understand open-loop and closed-loop HIL replay testing using dSPACE or other emulators.

  • You’re familiar with automotive safety and process standards, including ISO 26262, ASPICE and SOTIF, and have experience integrating requirements and test-management tools such as Jama and Xray.

  • You’re proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling, such as GitLab CI, Buildkite and Bazel.

  • You have experience developing or testing automotive software at embedded and system levels, including hardware/software interactions and interface-level testing, and have worked with L2+ hands-off, L3 or L4 automated driving systems.

  • You have knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols such as Euro NCAP, including AEB and LSS/LKA scenarios; DCAS regulatory testing under UN R171; and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards, including ISO/SAE 21434 and UN R155.

  • You’ve worked with test automation dashboards, logging and reporting infrastructure, using tools such as Grafana, Looker, Datadog and Jira.

  • You’re a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement who communicates clearly and works effectively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps and product teams.

  • Ideally, you’ve contributed to improvements in test methods, safety procedures or operational efficiency, and are familiar with data management and version control tools such as Git.

  • Experience using agentic AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code to accelerate and improve test development, debugging and automation workflows would also be valuable.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

  • Competency Interviews (Programming and hiring manager interview; 1 hour 45 minutes total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Cross-functional, system design; 1 hour 45 minutes total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (45 minutes).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

As part of our GTM Engineering team, you’ll partner with Sales, GTM Operations, Finance, Product & Engineering, and GTM leadership to deliver well-governed solutions across Salesforce and connected platforms like CPQ, NetSuite, Amplitude, and Snowflake.

What You'll Do

  • Hands-on platform administration, configuration, troubleshooting, maintenance, testing, upgrades, and user support

  • Maintain and optimize CPQ, pricing, quoting, and opportunity workflows to support the quote-to-cash process

  • Serve as the escalation line of support for Salesforce, handling escalated issues such as contract, entitlement, and provisioning discrepancies, driving root cause fixes

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with business stakeholders, gather requirements independently, and serve as a trusted partner for end users across the RevOps and Salesforce ecosystem.

  • Define and implement Salesforce standard operating procedures including but not limited to: field hygiene, data retention, integrations, permission sets, validation rules

  • Conduct regular system audits and health checks to proactively identify and resolve data quality issues

  • Manage pre-production and production environments, deploy changes using change sets or devops tooling, and ensure integrity of changes made to production systems.

  • Own Salesforce license allocation and forecasting, and monitor data storage against org limits

  • Build integrations, data flows, and install managed packages between Salesforce and external systems

  • Create and maintain system documentation for cross-team training, and participate in release planning, UAT, and post-deployment validation

  • Contribute as part of the GTM Engineering team to implement roadmap initiatives, working from design through testing and deployment.

  • Stay current with Salesforce platform changes and proactively recommend relevant new features or capabilities

Your First Six Months of Impact

  • Transition our reactive Salesforce support into an agent supported triage engine

  • Define a data retention strategy and identify opportunities to optimize data storage

  • Refine Salesforce RBAC for consistency across users and profiles

  • Respond to reactive CPQ questions independently

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of Salesforce administration experience, including hands-on work with Salesforce CPQ and quote-to-cash processes in a production revenue organization

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud and a functional understanding of CPQ, pricing rules, and the quote-to-contract-to-order handoff

  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining Apex (triggers, classes, batch/schedulable jobs), with the ability to read, troubleshoot, and safely extend existing code

  • Foundational knowledge of other Salesforce development concepts (Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, platform limits)

  • Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party tools via native connectors, managed packages, or integration platforms

  • Strong customer service orientation, with a genuine desire to help users work through problems

  • Certified Salesforce Administrator or similar experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce certifications such as CPQ Specialist, CPQ and Billing Consultant Accredited Professional, or Platform Developer I/II

  • Experience supporting Salesforce at a global, publicly traded company under SOX compliance

  • Experience with Salesforce CI/CD and release automation (e.g. Copado, GitHub) across sandboxes and production

  • Proven ability to lead Salesforce initiatives end to end, from solution design through release management and post-deployment support

Why This Role

You'll be a key contributor to the systems that power Amplitude's revenue engine, with direct ownership over the stability and scalability of our Salesforce ecosystem. This role offers the chance to work across a modern GTM tech stack and partner closely with stakeholders across the business, all while growing your technical depth in CPQ and quote-to-cash architecture.

This role is eligible for equity, benefits and other forms of compensation.

Some of our benefit programs include:

  • Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)

Other fun facts about Amplitude:

  • Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

title: Senior Video Editor and Motion Designer - 12 Month FTC
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact 

This role is within The Goat Agency, a leading brand within WPP Media, where you will be instrumental in helping global brands harness the power of social and creator-led content to deliver measurable impact. Recognised as a global leader in the space, we deliver award-winning campaigns in more than 70 countries. With over 650 social natives worldwide, we create ambitious influencer programmes from tactical activations to long-term partnerships, designed to drive awareness, engagementand conversions across the full marketing funnel. 

Skills and Experience
We are seeking a creative and motivated Senior Video Editor & Motion Designer to join our in-house production team. You will be in a key creative and technical role within the Campaigns team, responsible for editing and assembling video content specifically for client campaigns. This role focuses on transforming raw footage and assets into compelling, high-quality video deliverables that align with client briefs, campaign objectives, and brand guidelines. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end to end editing a variety of video content for client campaigns, including social media ads, case studies, promotional videos, and other campaign-specific assets.
  • Work from client briefs, storyboards, and producer direction to assemble footage, apply graphics, add music and sound effects, and ensure a high-quality final product.
  • Ensure all video edits are technically sound, creatively engaging, and effectively communicate the campaign message.
  • Adhere to client brand guidelines, campaign-specific style guides, and platform best practices (e.g., social media safe zones, aspect ratios).
  • Perform colour correction, sound mixing, and motion graphics to enhance video content.
  • Manage and organise video project files, footage, and assets efficiently.
  • Work quickly and efficiently to meet tight campaign deadlines without compromising quality.
  • Collaborate closely with Producers, Campaign Managers, Strategists, Account Managers, and other relevant team members to ensure video content aligns seamlessly with overall campaign strategy and messaging.
  • Collaborate with Producers to review edits, incorporate feedback, and make revisions as required.
  • Prepare final video files for delivery in various formats according to client and platform specifications.
  • Stay updated with the latest video editing techniques, software, and industry trends relevant to campaign content.
  • Provide creative input and suggestions during the editing process to enhance storytelling and visual impact.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues related to video editing software and workflows.
  • Be able to watch edits and point out areas where graphics, context, or snippets can be added with the ability to find and insert them.
  • Creatively review an edit, providing a fresh outlook on content with the confidence to offer ideas.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Video Editor, with a strong portfolio showcasing expertise in editing video content for various social media platforms, ideally within a campaign or client-focused environment.
  • Proficiency in professional video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve).
  • Strong understanding of video formats, codecs, and best practices for online video delivery.
  • Excellent storytelling skills and a keen eye for visual composition, pacing, and rhythm.
  • Ability to work creatively within brand guidelines and client briefs.
  • Experience with colour correction, sound design, and bespoke motion graphics.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality, polished video content.
  • Ability to manage multiple editing projects simultaneously and meet tight campaign deadlines.
  • Good organisational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure and adapt to feedback and revisions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with producers and other team members.
  • A proactive approach to learning new skills and staying current with editing technologies.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country. 

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location 

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide. 

 

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

  • Lead on planning RTBs, ensuring that they are best in class.

  • Oversees implementation and delivery of media activation. Manages workflow through activation teams. 
  • Oversees campaign reporting, ensuring insight is clear and actionable. 
  • Oversees campaign evaluation (PCAs) with support of Planning Manager / Planning Exec. 
  • Oversight of financial aspects of account (billings, reconciliations, accruals, finance queries). 
  • To foresee and pro-actively resolve planning issues with the team leadership. 
  • Leads key media updates (landscape, trends, research, media owner updates). 
  • Build a deep understanding of the brand’s vertical, competition and their business, to understand the challenges and opportunities they face. 
  • Champions WPP services, and agency capabilities. 
  • Supports integrated WoW across media & creative adopting ‘The Power of & ‘mindset.

  • Coach, support, and develop the Planning Manager and Planning Executive, with regular 1-2-1’s.  
  • Raise the profile of the account in the agency by producing, submitting, and publicly talking our work. 

Skills and Experience 

  • You are someone who both champions and challenges – themselves, their team, and their clients. 
  • Significant and relevant media planning experience, especially across ATL.  
  • A self-starter who demonstrates curiosity and works well in a fast-paced environment. 
  • High attention to detail with a drive to make sure the collective output is an excellent standard. 
  • Strong client management skills to manage both junior and senior clients, with gravitas. 
  • Proven track record of delivering strong comms planning outputs - with measurement at the forefront - to deliver against core objectives of a campaign. 
  • Strong presentation skills – both in creating / guiding content, and delivery

title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
description:
Mozilla Foundation is a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination.

We deliver people-first alternatives to today’s extractive systems. We build side by side with developers, innovators and advocates, united in the belief that a better technology future is not only possible — it’s ours to create!

Team

Our CEO is increasingly focused outward on the Board, funders, partners, and public conversations that will shape the Foundation’s next chapter. This newly created Chief of Staff role exists to extend the CEO’s reach inside the organization and make that outward focus possible.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll serve as the CEO’s strategic partner, internal proxy and trusted extension of their leadership. You’ll hold the CEO’s strategic agenda, translate the CEO’s priorities into organizational alignment, represent the CEO internally where needed, and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within clearly delegated authority. You’ll determine what reaches the CEO, prepare the CEO for consequential moments, and escalate only what requires the CEO’s judgment.

As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, you’ll partner strategically with other members of the ELT and work closely with the CEO’s Executive Program Manager to make sure the CEO’s time, priorities, and commitments stay aligned and moving.

You’ll also partner with the Foundation’s Investment Committee and its technical and strategic advisors, keeping their focus on the right questions, their recommendations aligned with the Foundation’s strategic priorities, and decisions moving efficiently from evaluation to funding.

Job responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll likely be focused on for the first 6 months:

  • Building a strong working partnership with the CEO, aligning on priorities, ways of working and clearly defining the scope of your delegated authority.
  • Establishing a trusted partnership with each member of the Executive Leadership Team, learning their priorities, pressures and ways of working.
  • Developing a deep, cross-functional understanding of the Foundation’s work and how each function connects to the CEO’s priorities.
  • Translating the CEO’s priorities into a concise, clear set of strategic outcomes that leaders understand and can use to guide the decisions they own, with a current view of what’s changing and which decisions are approaching.
  • Defining with the CEO what truly requires their attention, and ensuring issues reach them decision-ready, with context, options and a recommendation.
  • Getting up to speed with the Investment Committee and its advisors, and helping keep their focus on the right questions so decisions move efficiently from evaluation to funding.

As the Chief of Staff to Mozilla Foundation’s CEO, you will…

  • Serve as the CEO’s thought partner in developing, pressure-testing and refining strategic priorities, synthesizing executive insight and external developments to anticipate what will need to be known or decided in the next 30, 60 and 90 days.
  • Direct the CEO’s time toward strategy, external relationships, development, Board leadership and the Foundation’s highest-consequence decisions.
  • Filter rather than forward, so significant shifts in strategy, material risks, major budget decisions and Board-level matters reach the CEO early, with context, options and a recommendation.
  • Maintain a current view of the CEO’s top priorities, identify where work is drifting from strategic intent, and surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention before they become emergencies.
  • Enable the Executive Leadership Team to operate as one team around the CEO’s priorities, so the right issues reach the ELT at the right level and decisions and commitments are followed through.
  • Partner with ELT members on cross-functional issues that need CEO-level alignment but not the CEO’s direct involvement.
  • Represent the CEO’s position in internal discussions and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within delegated authority, bringing anything beyond it back to the CEO promptly.
  • Ensure the CEO enters every Board meeting, funder and partner conversation, speech and public engagement fully prepared, with concise briefings, organizational context and answers to likely questions.
  • Identify external opportunities that warrant the CEO’s attention, and ensure commitments the CEO makes externally translate into clear internal follow-through.
  • Steward alignment between the Investment Committee’s work and the Foundation’s strategy: keep its technical and strategic advisors focused on the right questions, surface gaps, risks or competing views, and bring forward matters that need the CEO’s judgment.

What this role is not

This is a role of influence. It exists to ensure the CEO can lead effectively through the Executive Leadership Team.

  • The Chief of Staff does not manage the Executive Leadership Team or run the Foundation’s operations. Each executive leader owns execution and decisions within their area.
  • This role does not make decisions beyond the authority the CEO has delegated. Anything outside that authority returns to the CEO.
  • This role does not have any direct reports and also doesn’t manage the CEO’s calendar, scheduling or administrative support.

Your Professional Profile

  • Significant, verifiable experience as a strategic partner at CEO or executive-team level, with a track record of leading high-stakes work and turning ambiguity into structure and action.
  • Experience working across multiple legal entities is a plus, including navigating differences, building influence, and coordinating work across entities where relevant. 
  • A proven record of driving complex, cross-functional priorities from idea to execution by defining outcomes, ownership, milestones and decision points.
  • Exceptional judgment and discretion, including handling confidential information and navigating complex executive dynamics with integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, build trust across functions and at the most senior levels, and give direct feedback with care.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication, with experience distilling complex information into decision-ready briefs, recommendations, presentations and executive communications.
  • Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills: you frame the right question, gather the right information, test assumptions and recommend a practical path forward.
  • Disciplined prioritization, with the agility to move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues without losing the thread.
  • Direct experience supporting Board governance, fundraising or other high-stakes external relationships at an executive level.
  • A track record of doing high-impact work out of the spotlight, measuring your success by the CEO’s and the team’s, and acting in the best interests of the CEO and the organization.
  • A demonstrated commitment to Mozilla Foundation’s mission and to building an open, accessible and trustworthy internet.
  • The ability to work across time zones and occasionally outside standard working hours for Board meetings, major events or urgent organizational needs.
  • Comfortable traveling for Board meetings, leadership gatherings and major events.

We Are Excited To See Any Additional Experience With:

  • Senior roles in nonprofit, philanthropic, technology or public-interest organizations.
  • Supporting or advising investment, grantmaking or funding committees.

How We Work

A few things that are true about how we work at Mozilla Foundation. Here's a summary along with our expectation of how these should show up in this role:

  • Move toward the hard thing: you surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention early, and give the CEO and executives direct, actionable input, including what they may not want to hear. You disagree constructively in the room, not afterward, and you don’t wait for someone else to raise it.
  • Stay curious and current: you stay close to what executives are seeing and what’s happening in our fields and communities, and turn it into the context the CEO needs. You pressure-test assumptions, including your own.
  • Work in the open: you document decisions and the reasoning behind them, so executives and teams can follow how and why priorities are set. You favor shared channels over side conversations wherever appropriate.
  • Focus and finish: you keep the CEO’s agenda focused on what matters most, make deliberate choices about what does and doesn’t need the CEO, and make sure decisions and commitments are seen through.
  • Flex with purpose: you move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues as context shifts, and adapt how you work with each executive. Flexibility isn’t about being agreeable; it’s staying responsive while holding to the mission and the CEO’s priorities.
  • Lead with care: you hold a high bar for the work while treating people as whole humans. You extend good faith to fellow executives, respect that each owns their area, and talk directly to the person who can solve the problem.

Salary and Benefits Information

Mozilla Foundation is dedicated to fair and equitable compensation for our staff. We aim to pay a competitive and market-based salary based on the responsibilities and requirements of the role. We do not ask for, or take into account, salary histories in our offer process.

The starting salary ranges for this role are listed below. 

  • Germany: €206,448.00 – €232,253.22
  • UK: £181,764.00 – £204,483.81
  • Canada: $356,400.00 – $400,948.65
  • US: $264,000.00 – $296,999.00

We also offer the following benefits:

  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Extended Sick Leave
  • Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Retirement Plan contributions
  • Paid Time Off: 20 days annual leave + sick days and your birthday
  • Company Holidays + EOY Shutdown
  • Wellness budget
  • Professional Development budget
  • Top up program for Pregnancy and Parental leaves

Benefits are subject to change at any time at the discretion of Mozilla Foundation.

Mozilla Foundation Hiring Practices

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation at -----

In this role, you will: 

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.

description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

This is a high-impact role that helps define how CoLab delivers technical value to its most strategic customers in Aerospace and Defence. CoLab is a category-creating product, which means adoption isn't just a rollout. It's a change in how the organization works.

In this role, you'd act as a trusted advisor, leveraging people, process, and technology to help teams rethink how they manage feedback, data, and decision-making across design and PLM. That means getting deep into customer workflows, testing new ways of working, and building repeatable methods the rest of the team can scale.

You'll work alongside a Customer Success Manager, and use what you learn on the front line to help shape product direction. This role isn't about selling or pitching. It's about deeply understanding engineering problems and solving them alongside the customer.

We are looking for a candidate in Switzerland to work regularly on-site with local CoLab customers.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’re a mechanical engineer by trade and have worked as a designer in an A&D company. You also understand the full product development life cycle: how design, manufacturing, quality, and engineering leadership depend on each other, and where collaboration breaks down. You can coach those teams toward working together better.

You know how to improve that life cycle with technology. Maybe you’ve championed internal tools or created automation or scripts.

You also know a process that makes sense on paper won’t get adopted on its own. You can meet people where they are, including the stakeholders who don’t want to change.

You don’t need to be the loudest voice in the room, but you can run a sprint and lead a cross-functional project. If the average person might find this job too undefined or complex, that probably excites you.

Job Responsibilities

  • Mapping a customer's current-state design review and engineering workflows, and defining the target-state process their teams will actually adopt.
  • Deploying and tuning CoLab's AI capabilities against a customer's own standards, drawing checklists, and design guidelines, and diagnosing what's working and what isn't.
  • Providing mechanical engineering expertise to validate AI-generated results and ensure engineering rigor.
  • Investigating and solving complex engineering data and integration challenges across PLM, ERP, QMS, and traditional design feedback tools.
  • Expanding adoption into new teams, programs, and sites within the account, partnering with the Customer Success Manager on where the next opportunity sits.
  • Collaborating with product teams to identify feature gaps, improve capabilities, and refine AutoReview.

Qualifications

Must-haves:

  • Background in mechanical design engineering, ideally in a medium- to large-sized organization.
  • Strong understanding of PLM & ERP systems and enterprise engineering data architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and cross-functional collaborations.
  • Experience working directly with customers or internal stakeholders to solve technical problems.
  • Comfort working in fast-changing, ambiguous environments.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of high-level AI architecture, specifically LLMs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, data integrations, and enterprise architecture concepts.
  • Located in Switzerland 

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with internal tool development, scripting, or automation.
  • Exposure to AI/ML tools applied to engineering workflows.
  • Prior work in design consulting or product development at scale.

Travel Expectations

While this is a fully remote role, travel is a consistent part of the job. There are two primary types of travel you can expect:

  • Team Weeks: Once per quarter, the sales team or entire company gets together in person. These typically involve traveling out on a Monday and returning on a Thursday or Friday. Two of these each year are held at our headquarters in St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada and the others take place in more central locations that evolve as the team grows.
  • On-sites: This role will work closely with a local customer with expectations to be on site with that customer, so there will likely be far less travel than our typical MFDE roll. That being said, in the event the local customer were to no longer work with us, the following is our standard MFDE travel expectations: “For most of our large deployment customers, we will visit on-site during kick-off and key expansion opportunities. Most on-sites involve 2-3 days with the customer, with travel on either side. Travel is primarily within North America, and you can expect 4 customer on-sites per quarter.”

Extra Details

  • This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options.
  • Unlimited paid vacation and extended health benefits 

Equity Note

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Your potential is what matters most to us.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. Vendor and Data Management

  • Support the evaluation, onboarding, and ongoing management of third-party data vendors across multiple international markets and product lines, ensuring alignment with business priorities and needs.

  • Maintain clear, auditable documentation regarding purchased data, vendor status, usage rights, contractual constraints, and performance across the data acquisition lifecycle.

  • Research and evaluate new international data sources aligned with Socure’s strategic priorities, particularly for identity verification, fraud prevention, KYC/eKYC, Document Verification, and compliance use cases.

title: Stage – Ingénieur(e) Production & Industrialisation
description: Isembard est une scale-up industrielle « software-first » qui reconstruit un réseau européen et souverain de fabrication de précision. Nous fabriquons des pièces usinées complexes (tournage, fraisage 5 axes) pour la défense, le spatial, les drones et l’aéronautique. Nous travaillons l’aluminium, l’acier inoxydable, le titane et d’autres alliages aéronautiques. Notre première usine française, à Wissous, monte rapidement en cadence, avec de nouvelles machines, de nouveaux clients et de nouveaux process. Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire ingénieur(e) pour rejoindre l’équipe fondatrice. Vous travaillerez directement avec notre Ingénieur Production fondateur. Vos missions Gestion de production : appuyer le suivi quotidien de la production et la planification. Vous contribuerez aussi au respect des délais de livraison des commandes clients. Standardisation des process : rédiger et déployer avec l’équipe des instructions de travail. Elles couvriront la réception des marchandises et des matières, les expéditions, le référencement fournisseurs, ainsi que la gestion des RFQ et des documents. Management de la qualité : contribuer à la construction de notre système qualité ISO 9001 et EN 9100. Cela comprend la traçabilité matière, les certificats, le processus de non-conformités (NCR) et l’inspection premier article (FAI). Capacité industrielle : aider à identifier, évaluer et intégrer des sous-traitants en usinage pour étendre nos capacités et notre savoir-faire. Lean & performance : animer et soutenir les démarches 5S en atelier. Équipements & digital : participer à la mise en service des nouvelles machines et au déploiement de nos logiciels d’usine développés en interne (ERP, stocks, traçabilité). Projets : porter un ou deux projets d’amélioration de bout en bout, du problème jusqu’à la solution déployée. Vos idées : si vous identifiez un sujet où vous pouvez contribuer au succès d’Isembard, proposez-le et nous le concrétiserons ensemble. Votre profil Étudiant(e) en école d’ingénieur (dernière année ou césure), en génie mécanique ou génie industriel. Intérêt pour l’usinage, les procédés de fabrication et la qualité. Savoir lire des plans techniques et le GD&T (cotation ISO GPS) est un plus. Structuré(e) et rigoureux(se), tout en étant à l’aise pour avancer vite dans une petite équipe sans management intermédiaire. Concret(e) et sur le terrain : vous aimez passer du temps en atelier, pas seulement derrière un écran. Français courant et bon niveau d’anglais, car nous échangeons chaque semaine avec notre siège à Londres. Bonus : des bases en Lean / Six Sigma. Pourquoi nous rejoindre De vraies responsabilités dès la première semaine, dans une usine en pleine construction. Une exposition directe à des clients de la défense, du spatial et de l’aéronautique et à leurs exigences qualité. Le mentorat d’un ingénieur production et supply chain expérimenté (Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, CPIM). Une scale-up en forte croissance, bien financée, avec une présence européenne. title: Stage M2 : Recherche en optique non linéaire appliquée à la caractérisation de dispositifs électroniques neuromorphiques - 6 mois
description: Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique. L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle. Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an). Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage : Des dispositifs d’électronique organique ultra-flexibles, conformables et implantables incorporant une intelligence artificielle promettent de révolutionner la surveillance et le traitement en temps réel de maladies chroniques [1]. De tels systèmes pourraient être basés sur des transistors organiques électrochimiques (OECTs), exploitant des conducteurs polymères mixtes ion-électron (PMIECs) comme couches actives. En effet, les PMIECs sont apparus comme une excellente plateforme matérielle pour interfacer la biologie avec l’électronique conventionnelle ; identifié comme le domaine de la « bioélectronique organique ou plastique ». L’OECT est considéré comme l’éléments clé pour réaliser une telle interface [2]. Son efficacité est évaluée suivant des figures de mérite (FoMs) telles que i) la transconductance (gm), et/ou ii) les temps de commutation (ionique vs. électronique) dans le dispositif. Au-delà des applications de transduction, à court terme, l’OECT est aussi intéressant pour créer des applications émergentes en matière de circuits neuromorphiques bioélectroniques [3]. La réalisation de tels circuits est freinée par un manque de compréhension et d’optimisation des processus de conduction mixte dans ces matériaux polymériques ; notamment une asymétrie des temps de commutation des transistors lors des séquences de dopage (i.e « ON ») vs dédopage (i.e « OFF ») dans le canal de l’OECT. Des outils de caractérisation in-situ & operando permettant de quantifier et cartographier les paramètres de transduction électronique et électrochimique dans le canal de l’OECT se révèlent être indispensables pour comprendre les limitations actuelles en performances des PMIECs et/ou pour construire des PMIECs optimums dans de tels circuits neuromorphiques. Dans ce contexte scientifique, le.la stagiaire développera une nouvelle mesure de spectroscopie et instrumentation d’optique non linéaire, appelée microscopie par génération de second harmonique résolue en temps, afin d’enregistrer le mouvement spatio-temporel des espèces chargées, ion et électrons (ou trous), et ainsi donc cartographier les mobilités électroniques in-situ & operando le canal de l’OECT. La.le stagiaire fabriquera ces dispositifs OECTs en salle blanche de microélectronique, et bénéficiera d’un accompagnement technique pour leur réalisation. Il.elle enregistrera et analysera les FoMs clés grâce à l'expérimentation d’optique non linéaire développée et aux caractérisations électriques et électrochimiques afin d’établir, de manière plus globale, des règles d’ingénierie dans ces PMIECs qui serviront de socle de connaissances incontournables à l’avenir, pour mettre en œuvre et appliquer des circuits neuromorphiques à base d'OECTs, comme première brique d’une intelligence artificielle d’électronique organique. Pour aller plus loin : [1] https://iconic.mines-stetienne.fr/ [2] https://doi.org/10.1038/ s43586-021-00065-8 [3] https://www.nature.com/articles/s41578-023-00622-5 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous La candidate ou le candidat devra être en cours de formation et d’apprentissage d’un diplôme de Master 2 ou de 3ème année de diplôme d’ingénieurs en Techniques Optiques et Instrumentations. La candidate ou le candidat devra disposer d’une culture solide en Physique/ Science des Matériaux/ (Opto)Électronique par sa formation initiale et/ou son expérience professionnelle. Ce sujet de stage M2 Recherche a vocation d’être poursuivi en cycle de doctorat. Seul.e un.e étudiant.e intéressé.e pour continuer en doctorat sera donc retenu.e pour ce stage. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Les principaux critères d’évaluation du candidat seront les suivants (liste non exhaustive) : Maitrise technique et scientifique en Optique. Des expériences lors de précédents stages en optique non linéaire et/ou microscopie, analyse d’images par caméra scientifique sera considéré comme avantageuses, Maitrise d’instrumentation électronique (caméra sCMOS, oscilloscope, générateur de signaux et à délai, SMU,…) et d’analyse d’images sous ordinateur (Python, …), Aptitudes pour le travail interdisciplinaire et les collaborations pluridisciplinaires. Autonomie, initiative, Intérêt pour le travail en équipe et capacité à construire un projet de recherche dans ce contexte, Maitrise de l’anglais lu, écrit ; Qualité de la communication orale et écrite. 📩 Postulez Maintenant ! · Date limite de candidature : 15/12/2026 · Durée du stage : 6 mois · Début du stage : entre le 1er Janvier et le 1er Mars 2027 · Lieu du stage : Gardanne (13) - France · Gratifications : au taux horaire : 4,50 € par heure de présence effective Modalités de candidature : Les candidatures doivent être déposées sur la plateforme RECRUITEE, au plus tard le 15 décembre 2026 (CV, lettre de motivation) : https://institutminestelecom.recruitee.com/o/stage-recherche-en-optique-non-lineaire-appliquee-a-la-caracterisation-de-dispositifs-electroniques-neuromorphique Le poste est ouvert à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap. Dans le cadre de sa politique Égalité, Diversité et Inclusion, l’École des Mines de Saint Etienne est un employeur soucieux de l’équité de traitement entre les candidatures. Les candidats retenus à une audition seront informés dans les meilleurs délais. Une partie des échanges s’effectuera en anglais.
