About the role Deepgram's speech models are among the fastest and most accurate in the world, and today we run them at scale on NVIDIA GPUs. Our customers increasingly need those same models on hardware we don't control: non-NVIDIA accelerators, edge servers, and embedded platforms with their own inference runtimes, operator sets, and constraints. Getting Deepgram models onto those platforms, with as few changes to the model as possible and no changes to the hardware paradigm, is the job. As an Applied ML Engineer on the Partner Platform Engineering team, you sit one layer above the metal. You take a Deepgram model as it exists today and adapt it to run correctly and efficiently within a target platform's existing kernel and runtime paradigm: swapping or reshaping operators, adjusting architecture parameters, choosing quantization and precision schemes, and validating accuracy and latency on the real device. Where a standard kernel isn't enough, you work with our Embedded AI Engineers, who write the custom kernels, and fit the model to what they build. You also own the deployment process that gets those adapted models onto edge targets repeatably. This is not a research role and not a cloud-serving role. It is applied ML for edge deployment. It is a great fit for a senior engineer who has already shipped models to non-GPU or edge hardware and wants to do it across many platforms, or a staff-level engineer who wants to define how Deepgram ports speech models to new hardware. We'll set the level to your experience. What you'll do Port Deepgram speech models to non-NVIDIA and edge platforms, adapting model structure and parameters so they run within the target's existing operator set, runtime, and kernels with minimal modification. Own serving-side model decisions for edge targets: quantization and precision choices, operator substitution, graph rewrites, and architecture tweaks that fit a model to a device's constraints while holding accuracy and latency. Validate every port on real hardware: build accuracy, latency, throughput, and memory benchmarks per platform, and catch regressions before a customer does. Build the deployment path for edge targets: model packaging, conversion pipelines, versioning, and automated delivery so shipping a model to a new device is repeatable rather than bespoke. Work with Embedded AI Engineers when a standard kernel isn't enough: specify what the model needs, then adapt the model to use the custom kernel they deliver. Partner with platform and silicon vendors on their runtimes and toolchains, and turn their expected model format and operator conventions into a working Deepgram deployment. Feed edge constraints back to Research and Impeller so future models are easier to port, without taking on research or core productionization work yourself. As the team grows, take on adjacent production concerns at the edge: automated deployment, model security and integrity on customer hardware, and fleet-level observability. You'll love this role if you Have already fought to get a model running on hardware that wasn't built for it, and want to do that across many platforms. Prefer changing the model to fit the hardware over changing the hardware to fit the model, and know when each is the right call. Care about the numbers on the device, not the numbers in the notebook. Like being the bridge between the team writing kernels and the team training models. Want to ship to customers, not publish. raw.jobDescription:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

About the role

Deepgram's speech models are among the fastest and most accurate in the world, and today we run them at scale on NVIDIA GPUs. Our customers increasingly need those same models on hardware we don't control: non-NVIDIA accelerators, edge servers, and embedded platforms with their own inference runtimes, operator sets, and constraints. Getting Deepgram models onto those platforms, with as few changes to the model as possible and no changes to the hardware paradigm, is the job.

As an Applied ML Engineer on the Partner Platform Engineering team, you sit one layer above the metal. You take a Deepgram model as it exists today and adapt it to run correctly and efficiently within a target platform's existing kernel and runtime paradigm: swapping or reshaping operators, adjusting architecture parameters, choosing quantization and precision schemes, and validating accuracy and latency on the real device. Where a standard kernel isn't enough, you work with our Embedded AI Engineers, who write the custom kernels, and fit the model to what they build. You also own the deployment process that gets those adapted models onto edge targets repeatably.

This is not a research role and not a cloud-serving role. It is applied ML for edge deployment. It is a great fit for a senior engineer who has already shipped models to non-GPU or edge hardware and wants to do it across many platforms, or a staff-level engineer who wants to define how Deepgram ports speech models to new hardware. We'll set the level to your experience.

What you'll do

  • Port Deepgram speech models to non-NVIDIA and edge platforms, adapting model structure and parameters so they run within the target's existing operator set, runtime, and kernels with minimal modification.

  • Own serving-side model decisions for edge targets: quantization and precision choices, operator substitution, graph rewrites, and architecture tweaks that fit a model to a device's constraints while holding accuracy and latency.

  • Validate every port on real hardware: build accuracy, latency, throughput, and memory benchmarks per platform, and catch regressions before a customer does.

  • Build the deployment path for edge targets: model packaging, conversion pipelines, versioning, and automated delivery so shipping a model to a new device is repeatable rather than bespoke.

  • Work with Embedded AI Engineers when a standard kernel isn't enough: specify what the model needs, then adapt the model to use the custom kernel they deliver.

  • Partner with platform and silicon vendors on their runtimes and toolchains, and turn their expected model format and operator conventions into a working Deepgram deployment.

  • Feed edge constraints back to Research and Impeller so future models are easier to port, without taking on research or core productionization work yourself.

  • As the team grows, take on adjacent production concerns at the edge: automated deployment, model security and integrity on customer hardware, and fleet-level observability.

You'll love this role if you

  • Have already fought to get a model running on hardware that wasn't built for it, and want to do that across many platforms.

  • Prefer changing the model to fit the hardware over changing the hardware to fit the model, and know when each is the right call.

  • Care about the numbers on the device, not the numbers in the notebook.

  • Like being the bridge between the team writing kernels and the team training models.

  • Want to ship to customers, not publish.

It's important to us that you have

  • Hands-on experience deploying ML models to edge or non-NVIDIA hardware in production. This is required. Cloud-only or GPU-only serving experience does not qualify on its own.

  • Working knowledge of quantization and precision tradeoffs (INT8, FP16, mixed precision, calibration) and how they affect accuracy and latency on real targets.

  • Experience with at least one edge or vendor inference runtime and its conversion toolchain (for example ONNX Runtime, TFLite, ExecuTorch, OpenVINO, Qualcomm AI Engine, or a vendor NPU SDK).

  • Ability to modify a model to fit a platform: reading and rewriting model graphs, swapping unsupported operators, and adjusting architecture parameters without breaking accuracy.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch, and production-quality engineering habits: tests, reproducibility, and benchmarks that others can rerun.

  • Comfort building automation around model conversion and deployment.

  • A builder mindset and clear communication: you can scope a port on an unfamiliar platform and drive it to a measured result.

It would be great if you had

  • Experience with speech, audio, or streaming/real-time models specifically.

  • Exposure to writing or reading low-level kernels (CUDA, Metal, NEON, or vendor DSP code), enough to collaborate closely with embedded engineers.

  • Experience with model security or integrity on deployed devices: signing, encrypted model storage, safe updates.

  • Familiarity with several accelerator families (Qualcomm, Apple, ARM, Intel, AMD, or custom NPUs) and their quirks.

  • A track record of building internal tooling that made porting or deploying models measurably faster.

raw.description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

We're looking for a Bookkeeper to bring our day-to-day bookkeeping and month-end close in-house. You'll be our first dedicated bookkeeper, taking over from our external accounting firm and running the books for our growing group: five Dutch BVs today, plus our entities abroad.

Our transaction volume has roughly doubled this year, and 2027 is the first financial year our accounts will be audited. You'll own the reconciliations, records and close process that make our numbers reliable, working closely with our finance lead, purchasing team and external accountants. The external accountants will continue to handle annual accounts and corporate tax, with local advisors handling tax filings abroad.

This is a hands-on bookkeeping role for someone with at least three years of experience running the full cycle through month-end. Our data and processes need cleaning up. If you enjoy turning a messy administration into a tidy one, this is that job. As you settle in, there is room to take on VAT filing and monthly payroll processing.

The role is based at our Amsterdam HQ, on-site five days a week. Salary is up to €50,000 gross a year, including the 8% holiday allowance.

What you'll do

  • Own daily bookkeeping. Code supplier invoices and card spend in Spendesk with the right GL account, VAT code and cost centre, and post them to the general ledger without re-keying. Keep supplier records clean and prepare payment runs. Supplier bank-detail changes are independently verified and approved; payment approval and release sit with the finance lead.

  • Keep accounts reconciled. Reconcile bank accounts, keep payables and receivables current, and investigate outstanding items so every balance is supported or explained.

  • Run the month-end close. Close all entities to a fixed timetable, initially by working day eight and moving towards working day five. Own accruals, prepayments and balance-sheet reconciliations, collect or prepare foreign entities' figures, agree intercompany balances and reconcile group reporting to the ledgers.

  • Maintain fixed assets and inventory records. Keep the fixed-asset register up to date, including capitalisation and depreciation of our robot fleet under agreed accounting policies, and reconcile inventory accounts to month-end stock values.

  • Prepare Dutch VAT returns. Prepare quarterly btw returns with our external accountants reviewing, and take over filing them over time.

  • Keep the books audit-ready. Maintain supporting schedules and an audit file throughout the year. Be a day-to-day contact for our external accountants and support the audit of our 2027 accounts.

  • Improve how we work. Document the close, fix recurring errors and use spreadsheets, software and AI tools to reduce manual work while checking the results carefully. Depending on your experience, take on payroll processing in Loket over time, with payroll tax filings remaining with our external accountants.

What we're looking for

  • Full-cycle bookkeeping experience. You have at least three years of experience running the books through month-end, at an accounting firm (accountantskantoor) or in-house.

  • Hands-on Dutch VAT experience. You've prepared Dutch btw returns and can work through the supporting records.

  • Strong reconciliation skills. You've handled balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals and prepayments, beyond processing invoices. You investigate differences and follow them through to a resolution.

  • Accuracy and ownership. You keep records organised, meet close deadlines and raise missing information or accounting questions early. You'd rather find the €12 difference than book it to suspense.

  • Fluent English and professional working Dutch. English is our working language, and your manager doesn't speak Dutch. You can independently read and process Dutch invoices, tax correspondence and payroll documents.

  • Comfort with systems and confidential information. You work confidently with spreadsheets, learn new accounting tools and handle financial and employee information carefully.

  • Nice to have: Twinfield, Basecone or Spendesk (Exact, Odoo or similar also counts); multi-entity or multi-country bookkeeping, intercompany and consolidation; fixed-asset or inventory accounting in hardware or manufacturing; statutory audit support; Dutch payroll experience, ideally in Loket; an accounting qualification such as MBO-4/HBO, SPD or Praktijkdiploma Boekhouden; experience automating repetitive work.

Why Monumental?

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you.

title: Privacy & AI Officer
description: Wil jij bijdragen aan een organisatie die in control is op het gebied van privacy en verantwoorde inzet van AI? En weet jij wet- en regelgeving te vertalen naar duidelijke processen en praktisch advies? Als Privacy & AI Officer help je afdelingen zorgvuldig om te gaan met persoonsgegevens en AI-risico’s tijdig te herkennen. Je adviseert, coördineert, bewaakt en rapporteert. Zo maak jij het verschil voor onze leden, collega’s en de continuïteit van Univé Zuid-Nederland! Wie ben jij? Daarnaast breng je mee: Hbo+ werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een juridische richting. Diepgaande kennis van de AVG, privacywetgeving en relevante wet- en regelgeving. Praktische kennis van de AVG en ervaring met bijvoorbeeld DPIA’s, datalekken of privacyprocessen. Kennis van en interesse in AI-governance, AI-beleid, de AI Act en het beheersen van AI-risico’s. Ervaring met het implementeren en bewaken van beleid, regelingen en processen. Sterk analytisch vermogen, zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming en resultaatgerichtheid. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om belanghebbenden mee te nemen. Wat ga je doen Als Privacy en AI Officer ondersteun je afdelingen bij het naleven van de AVG, het Univé privacybeleid en het AI-beleid. Maar pak je ook (pro-)actief zelf activiteiten op in het kader van dit aandachtsgebied. Je hebt een spilfunctie in het vroegtijdig onderkennen en beheersen van privacy- en AI-risico’s. Je adviseert je collega’s in de eerste lijn, coördineert de implementatie van beleid en zorgt voor het onderhoud en de naleving van privacy-instrumenten en processen. Daarnaast registreer, coördineer en beheer je AI-toepassingen, AI-risico’s en relevante beheersmaatregelen. Je helpt bij AI-use cases, naleving van wet- en regelgeving en verantwoord gebruik en rapporteert hierover. Ook speel je een actieve rol in beleidsontwikkeling en advisering. Je volgt wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving en vertaalt deze naar de praktijk. Zo help je Univé Zuid-Nederland om aantoonbaar in control te blijven. Het zwaartepunt van de functie ligt bij privacy, waarmee jij vanuit de eerste lijn waarde toevoegt in dit domein. AI speelt daarin een aanvullende rol en er is ruimte om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen, net als de organisatie dat doet. Je adviseert niet alleen: je helpt ook zelf bij de uitvoering waarbij je samenwerkt met de eerste lijn business owners. Juist die combinatie maakt deze functie afwisselend en zichtbaar waardevol voor de organisatie. title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
description: Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg. Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan: KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen. Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam. Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken. Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur; 8% vakantiegeld; Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris; 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen; €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen; Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden; Goede pensioenregeling; Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor; Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team; Zullen we kennismaken? Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien. Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase. Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Wil je samen met een team consultants bijdragen aan complexe vraagstukken, het ontwikkelen van slimme inzichten en deze vertalen naar strategische oplossingen? Dan is deze stage bij Berenschot iets voor jou.

In deze meewerkstage help je mee aan het oplossen van strategische en operationele vraagstukken van klanten uit de industrie: je bekijkt hun grootste uitdagingen op het gebied van strategische positionering, product- en marktkeuzes,, procesoptimalisatie en digitalisering.

Dit ga je doen

Je gaat meewerken aan diverse opdrachten voor klanten uit de industrie en het bredere bedrijfsleven, zoals het ontwikkelen van een nieuwe strategie, het in beeld brengen van een markt of sector, het verbeteren van de operationele processen, het implementeren van technologische innovaties en het organiseren van transformaties voor groei en prestatieverbetering. Bij ‘industrie’ denken we onder meer aan de maakindustrie, defensie-industrie, voedselverwerkende industrie en hightechindustrie.

Je komt te werken in een platte organisatie die altijd openstaat voor nieuwe en innovatieve ideeën, waar je veel vrijheid krijgt om te leren én om mee te denken.

Voorbeelden van projecten waaraan jij meehelpt:

  • Begeleiding van strategische workshops om de strategie van de organisatie te herijken.

  • Doen van marktonderzoek voor een servicepartner in scheepsmotoren.

  • Verbeteren van de kwaliteit en doorlooptijd van het productieproces bij een fabrikant van auto-onderdelen door toepassing van Lean Six Sigma.

  • Optimaliseren van productieprocessen door gebruik van data van een producent van verzorgingsproducten.

  • Realiseren van bedrijfsbrede performanceverbetering en kostenbesparing bij een offshore-organisatie.

Daarnaast help je mee aan het schrijven van offertes en het maken van pitchdecks van nieuwe opdrachten en het verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Het is mogelijk om een stageonderzoek parallel te doen aan je periode bij Berenschot zolang er ook voldoende tijd beschikbaar blijft om te helpen met klantopdrachten en je daarin te ontwikkelen.

Quote

‘Bij Berenschot bepaal je vaak zelf wat je wilt leren en als stagiair werk je meteen mee aan echte projecten bij onze klanten.’ — Nick Fierloos, junior consultant (voormalig stagiair)

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je gaat werken in het team Strategy & Operations, onderdeel van de adviesgroep Transformatie van Organisaties. Het team bestaat uit zeventien slimme en enthousiaste adviseurs die werken in verschillende sectoren. Zij combineren hun kennis van de markt, strategie en operationele bedrijfsprocessen om scherpe analyses en adviezen te maken. Het team kenmerkt zich door een sterke collegiale band waarbij hard werken, teamwork, het beste uit jezelf en elkaar te halen, impact en plezier maken hand in hand gaan. Met slimme en gedreven Berenschotters om je heen werk je samen aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen.


Dit neem je mee

We zoeken iemand die:

  • ervaring heeft met Microsoft Office (PowerPoint en Excel)

  • gevoel heeft voor rapporteren en visuele presentatie van informatie

  • basiskennis heeft van strategie, organisatiestructuren en bedrijfsprocessen

  • passie heeft voor innovatie, leergierig is en goed kan samenwerken

  • proactief is en opdrachten zelfstandig oppakt

  • uitstekend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft

  • bij voorkeur 12 maanden beschikbaar is, maar minimaal 6 maanden bij ons komt.

title: Medior/Senior R&D Engineer Interoperability in Battle Labs & Experimentation (m/v/x/)
description: Ben jij een specialist op het gebied van computernetwerken en protocollen en heb je affiniteit met het toepassen van simulatie- en trainingssystemen in een R&D context? Als netwerk-expert binnen onze afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor onderzoek en ontwikkeling gericht op netwerken en systemen die verschillende simulatoren en operationele systemen veilig en efficiënt met elkaar verbinden. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met onder andere softwareontwikkelaars, domeinexperts en toekomstige eindgebruikers aan innovatieve oplossingen voor nationale en internationale stakeholders. Je bent hiervoor bereid om te reizen naar verschillende locaties, voornamelijk binnen Nederland. Wat breng je mee? Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten! Daarnaast: Heb je een afgeronde bachelor of master opleiding in ICT, Computer Science, Informatica, Informatiekunde, of vergelijkbaar; Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 5 jaar ervaring op het gebied van netwerktechnologie, TCP/UDP, netwerkprotocollen, routering, switching en netwerkbeveiliging; Beheers je meerdere programmeertalen zoals C, C++, C#, Java en ervaring in scripting om experimenteeromgevingen snel op te zetten of aan te passen; Heb je interesse in experimenteren, wargaming en simulatie in een R&D-context; Heb je ervaring met het ontwerpen en beheren van robuuste, schaalbare netwerkomgevingen; Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties; Werk je graag samen, durft je te experimenteren en kan je technische keuzes uitleggen aan niet-technische collega’s; Kan jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken. Nice to have: Ervaring met of interesse in simulatie- en interoperabiliteitsprotocollen (DIS/HLA/FOMs); Ervaring met het opzetten van tijdelijke of experimentele infrastructuren; Kennis van netwerkbeveiliging of VPN-oplossingen; Ervaring met monitoring- of observabilitytools; Interesse in nieuwe technologieën zoals autonome systemen, AI in simulatie of digitale twins. Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken op dit moment rond de 100 deskundigen op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, training, luchtvaart en psychologie. De afdeling beschikt over allerlei onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een battlelab en simulatoren voor gevechtsvliegtuig- en onbemande systemen en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. raw.jobDescription:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

About the Job

Build the graph that decides who’s real. Every day, Socure’s Identity Graph helps businesses decide whether to trust the person on the other side of a screen. It links billions of signals (names, addresses, devices, emails, phones) into one picture of identity, and it does this in milliseconds. Fraudsters move fast. The graph has to be faster.

As a Staff Engineer on this team, you’ll set the technical direction for the platform behind that decision. You’ll own hard problems end to end, work across Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Security, and see your work shape the products that protect millions of people.

What You Will Do

  • Shape the graph. Define the schemas, relationships, and ontology that make identity data consistent and extensible.

  • Own entity resolution at scale. Decide how records, people, devices, and addresses connect, and how confident we are, across data that is messy, sparse, and sometimes adversarial.

  • Build for speed and volume. Design batch and real-time pipelines, low-latency APIs, and serving systems that hold up under heavy load.

  • Power fraud intelligence. Ship the production systems behind our ML features, model inference, and graph analytics.

  • Move the numbers. Improve performance, reliability, and cost, and prove it with measurements.

  • Set the direction. Lead architecture decisions, document the tradeoffs, and carry initiatives from first design through production rollout.

  • Raise the bar. Mentor engineers and set the standard for design reviews, testing, CI/CD, and operations.

  • Protect identity data. Build privacy, security, and PII protection into every system from day one.

  • Your toolkit: Java, Scala, or Python. Spark, Kafka, Flink, Airflow, and AWS, including EMR. Graph technologies like Neo4j and Amazon Neptune.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field

  • 7+ years building and running distributed systems in the cloud, with at least 2 at Staff or Senior Staff scope, or the equivalent

  • Production scale you can quantify. You can tell us what you built, how big it was, and how much you improved latency, reliability, or cost

  • Deep Spark, Kafka, or Flink experience in both batch and streaming, including debugging them in production

  • Low-latency serving. You have built and tuned APIs where milliseconds matter

  • Graph or entity-resolution experience. You have modeled connected data, matched records across noisy sources, or built an identity graph. Fraud or identity verification is a strong plus

  • Cloud and operations fluency. AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and real production observability

  • ML data pipelines on Databricks, SageMaker, or similar, plus orchestration with Airflow or equivalent

  • Technical leadership. You have led ambiguous, cross-team work, mentored engineers, and changed the direction of a system through design docs and influence, not authority

What This Job is Not

  • It’s not a role for someone who hasn’t owned a system end to end in production, including being on call for it.

  • It’s not feature work on platforms someone else designed.

  • It’s not a defined backlog. You’ll frame ambiguous problems yourself.

  • It’s not a place to treat data privacy as a compliance checkbox.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer, Robotics Platform
description: At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity. Who We Are We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain robotics middleware and application frameworks using modern C++ on embedded Linux. Own significant platform components from technical design and implementation through validation, deployment, and operation across Serve’s robot fleet. Partner with software teams using the robot platform to identify reliability, performance, and developer experience problems and deliver reusable solutions. Collaborate with Autonomy and Systems Engineering on risk assessments, failure analysis, fault-handling strategies, and software architecture. Translate system-level safety and reliability requirements into software behavior, interfaces, and verification strategies. Develop instrumentation, benchmarks, logging, tracing, and fleet-level metrics to measure and improve software performance, reliability, and system health. Diagnose and resolve complex system-level issues involving concurrency, scheduling, interprocess communication, networking, and constrained compute resources. Evaluate technical tradeoffs and contribute to architectural decisions that improve the scalability, maintainability, and reliability of the robotics platform. Lead technical design and code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, development practices, and technical documentation. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers through design discussions, problem solving, and knowledge sharing. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience developing production software in modern C++ (C++17 and newer). Experience developing and debugging systems software in embedded Linux environments. Strong understanding of multithreaded programming, concurrency, synchronization, interprocess communication, and systems-level software development. Experience designing software for latency-sensitive, safety-related, real-time, or high-reliability systems. Experience profiling and optimizing embedded software for performance, reliability, and resource utilization. Experience independently owning complex software components through design, implementation, testing, and deployment. If you’re driven by curiosity, thrive in complexity, and want to help build the system that brings true understanding to enterprise AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

You'll sit with executives, domain experts, and data teams to find the decisions that actually move their business - inventory that's in the wrong place, risk concentrations nobody can see, fraud patterns that only emerge across three systems, capacity plans built on guesses. Then you'll model their world in our ontology, formulate the reasoning problem, write the PyRel, and ship something that runs against their real data in their own Snowflake account.

Every engagement here produces two deliverables.

The first is the one the customer sees: a working decision system that changes how they operate.

The second is the one that matters most to us: the pile of things you had to invent because our platform didn't have them yet. The modelling pattern you hand-rolled. The constraint formulation that should have been a primitive. The three-hour workaround where an API should have existed. You bring those back, you argue for them, and the strongest of them become product.

That second deliverable is why this role exists. If you only ever deliver the first one, we've hired a consultant. We're not hiring consultants.

You'll operate with unusual autonomy: you decide what's worth building, when a workaround is acceptable and when it's technical debt we'll regret, and when to tell a customer their real problem is not the one they asked about. You'll be technical enough that when something breaks in a customer environment, you find the root cause yourself rather than filing a ticket and waiting.

What You'll Do

  • Own outcomes end to end - discovery, modelling, implementation, performance tuning, production hardening, and the measurement that proves it worked. Not a handoff at each stage. Yours.
  • Build, not describe - design and ship decision solutions on our modelling, reasoning, and learning stack: ontologies over customer data, rules, graph analytics, optimisation formulations, predictive models
  • Fill the gaps yourself - when a customer workflow is blocked on something the platform doesn't do, scope it and build it. Then push the general version upstream: read our source, form a hypothesis before you escalate, open the PR.
  • Close the loop with Product - every deployment generates a signal. Bring back reproductions, patterns, and specific failure modes ("the only way I could express this was by abusing X in this way"), not vibes. You are one of the loudest inputs into our roadmap.

Who You Are

You thrive in ambiguity and move with intent. You're motivated by deep understanding and meaningful impact.

  • Owner, not participant. You take full accountability for the outcome, not your slice of it. When something is broken and it's nobody's job, it becomes yours.

  • Rigorous. You root-cause things. You can explain both why it broke and why your fix works. Surface symptoms don't satisfy you.

Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on AI Developer to help build it.

Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role.

You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work.

Key Responsibilities

AI / LLM Engineering (core focus)

  • Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality.
  • Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources.
  • Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features.
  • Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs.
  • Grow into model optimization over time: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, and offline/air-gapped deployments.

DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting)

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used).
  • Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker.
  • Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting.
  • Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.
  • Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers).
  • 3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling.
  • Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have).
  • Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus.
  • DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).
  • Strong problem-solving & communication with a root-cause troubleshooting mindset, self-directed learning, strong ownership, and seamless remote/distributed team collaboration.

title: Staff Software Engineer - OpenTelemetry Python instrumentation | UK | Remote
description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from Germany, UK, Ireland and Spain. The Opportunity: Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it. The OpenTelemetry SDKs team's mission is to make sure our users succeed in instrumenting their software with OpenTelemetry. We work closely with the OpenTelemetry SIGs to make OpenTelemetry SDKs and instrumentation libraries a success. Members of this team are experts in at least one programming language and have a broad knowledge of various other programming languages. In this role, you will focus on a language-specific implementation of OpenTelemetry in Python , with an emphasis on OpenTelemetry for Generative AI . You will get to work in an upstream-first approach, helping accelerate the OpenTelemetry project while bringing the innovations to Grafana labs products and offerings. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. We are looking for Engineers that are passionate about communicating with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities. At Grafana Labs, ICs have a dedicated career path and do not have to become managers to progress in their career. Staff Software Engineers at Grafana have a large amount of experience across multiple areas. They are able to estimate, plan, coordinate and deliver large tasks spanning multiple systems. They actively coach and mentor other team members in their team and are able to identify and resolve issues with technology and product processes. What You’ll Be Doing: You will bring your software engineering expertise to develop improvements to the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, with a strong focus on AI applications and agent workflows. This is a hands-on role for someone with deep Python expertise and an interest in AI. Collaborate in open-source communities. You will develop and maintain the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, working with maintainers and other vendors on specifications, APIs, and implementation decisions. Build Python instrumentation for AI agents. Build instrumentation that connects agent runs, model calls, and tool execution, including across asynchronous code. Contribute to evolving OpenTelemetry conventions for generative AI, with care for sensitive data and metric cardinality. Improve Python SDK performance. Use profiling and benchmarks to evaluate implementation approaches with the upstream community. Make sound tradeoffs around runtime overhead, compatibility, and maintainability. Be visible as an OpenTelemetry expert. Teach others, promote best practices around OpenTelemetry, semantic conventions, and various technologies and frameworks. Both within Grafana Labs and in the broader OpenTelemetry community. Support the technical direction and vision of the team, and contribute to business conversations on the OpenTelemetry strategy at Grafana Labs. Own projects from an ambiguous problem through design, implementation, testing, documentation, and release. Partner in an open and respectful way. Lend your knowledge and skills to our GTM, Product and Support teams. Join customer conversations, investigate instrumentation issues, and turn what you learn into fixes and practical guidance. As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so high agency and good communication skills are a must. What Makes You a Great Fit: At Grafana Labs, Staff Engineers are defined by the impact they have and the people they enable. You take ownership of complex problems, set technical direction, and help others deliver improvements that matter to customers and the OpenTelemetry community. 8+ years of experience in software development, with strong proficiency in Python and experience debugging production software, language internals, libraries, and asynchronous code. An interest in AI applications and agent systems, and curiosity about how to instrument and troubleshoot them. Prior experience building AI systems is helpful, but not required. Experience working in open-source communities. You are eager to become an active member of the OpenTelemetry community, collaborate with maintainers and users, and keep learning across languages, frameworks, and the wider observability ecosystem. Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry, alongside experience with cloud-based software or systems engineering. You understand production environments and can assess operational risks. Bonus Points For: You have experience working on open source observability projects, ideally in OpenTelemetry or Prometheus. Experience in Python instrumentation techniques, profiling, runtime diagnostics, or asynchronous context propagation Experience in a hands-on technical leadership role, setting technical direction and leading project teams Experience instrumenting AI frameworks or agent workflows, or working with OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI Experience contributing to or maintaining Open Source projects, with evidence of successful pull requests and community collaboration Rust experience is a plus for exploring potential Python SDK performance improvements, including Rust-backed implementations. Compensation & Rewards: In the UK, the compensation range for this role is GBP 107,000 - GBP 134,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Spain and Germany.

Our frontend stack is primarily TypeScript and React, interacting with backends written in Go. Frontend engineers at Grafana also have opportunities to contribute to open source communities.

  • Own technical projects from problem framing through rollout, including getting user feedback and measuring whether what you shipped actually worked.

About Nebius:

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

The Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to build software that makes network operations safe, scalable, and boring — even as we launch new data centers and expand fast. This is not a “write scripts for configs” role: you’ll build the tooling and services that sit between the network core (switches/ports/VLANs, traffic processors) and the cloud platform on top, using open source where it fits and building the missing pieces where it doesn’t.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build and maintain services and tooling that automate the network lifecycle: day-0 provisioning, day-N changes, drift detection, and operational verification
  • Make network changes safe and transparent: CI/CD workflows, diff/review tooling, staged rollouts/rollbacks, audit trails, and guardrails
  • Develop observability systems that scale across many sites: telemetry pipelines, signal quality, and tooling that shortens incident investigations
  • Close “last mile” gaps between the network and the platform: integrate source-of-truth data, expose APIs, and build reliable automation around it
  • Collaborate closely with network engineers and SREs to turn real operational pain into product-quality tooling

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent practical background)
  • Strong coding skills and ownership mindset: you can ship and operate reliable services
  • Proficiency in Go or readiness to switch; Python is also welcome (other languages can be useful for OSS debugging/fixes)
  • You don’t have to be Network expert but we expect you to have interest in infrastructure and/or network

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Background in networking (ex-network engineer, CCNP/education, DC networking exposure) or strong interest and proven ability to learn fast
  • Experience building automation/infra tooling: CI/CD, IaC, testing/staging environments, or “network-as-code” style workflows
  • Low-level networking / datapath experience: eBPF/XDP, DPDK, kernel networking, traffic processing systems
  • Experience designing high-load services and observability platforms (metrics/logs/traces, alerting, regression detection)
  • Contributions to open source or experience extending/debugging OSS components in production environments

We expect Engineers to:

  • Manage large-scale projects involving multiple stakeholders
  • Break down complex tasks and guide both their own work and that of more junior colleagues
  • Be experts in specific technologies and write high-quality code that can serve as a reference
  • Assess task priority and focus on high-impact work, avoiding low-value efforts
  • Have strong architectural thinking and contribute to system design
  • Be involved in hiring and actively contribute to interviews
  • Be willing to share knowledge and mentor others

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: GTM Engineering - ShareGate
description: Company Description Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent , our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here. Your role ShareGate’s customers generate rich signals (product usage, support interactions, renewal dates), but those signals aren’t yet connected into an engine that protects and grows the revenue we already have. As our GTM Architect, Expansion & Retention, you’ll design, build and ship AI agents and agentic workflows that turn those signals into saved renewals and cross-sell pipeline. This is an embedded engineering role within GTM, not back-office ops: you’ll apply the signal-based, agent-first approach we already use for new customer acquisition to the customers we already have. Your impact: Protect renewals by building AI agents that continuously monitor renewal health and flag at-risk accounts to Account Managers early, with context, recommended next steps and enough lead time to act. Grow revenue from our existing customers by designing and running an agentic cross-sell motion: score fit for our second product line, research each account, personalize outreach, qualify interest and route genuine intent to the right salesperson with the full context needed to close. Define the signals your agents need and partner with Revenue Systems, which builds and owns the data flow between product usage and the CRM. Validate the data with SQL before you act on it. Replace manual workflows with AI agents and reusable pipeline modules (not one-off automations) that Account Management and Sales can run and own on their own. Tune both motions by owning reporting on pipeline generated, conversion, renewal outcomes and revenue impact, and by running controlled experiments without adding headcount. Drive adoption by turning everything you build into SOPs, demos and playbooks, so the team uses what you ship, not just appreciates it. Your team You’ll join a GTM engineering effort that already runs a signal-based, agent-first approach to new customer acquisition, and now points it at the customers we already have. The challenge: connect usage, support and renewal signals into agents that reduce the friction between signal and action. The tools, plays and channels will evolve; that mission won’t. Our stack: low-code orchestration (n8n, Make, Zapier or similar), Python or TypeScript, SQL on our data warehouse, and our CRM (HubSpot). What you'll bring Background in RevOps, GTM/marketing operations, customer success operations or GTM engineering, with hands-on experience building automation; Hands-on experience with low-code orchestration (n8n, Make, Zapier or similar), plus working knowledge of Python or TypeScript for API integrations and data transformation; fluency with agentic tools and MCP connectors. Strong LLM workflow design (agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation), sound judgment on when AI adds leverage versus complexity, and a track record of shipping AI agents or LLM workflows to real users, not just prototypes; Working SQL to query and validate usage, support and renewal data., so you can build and trust the data behind your agents; CRM fluency (HubSpot a plus): enough to design agents on our data model and work with Revenue Systems on what you need. Understanding of subscription business metrics (renewal rate, net retention, customer lifetime value), and experience with or strong interest in outbound and signal-based go-to-market motions; The ability to work directly with Sales and Account Management, translate complex builds into plain language, and earn adoption through demos and handoff docs, without a PM to bridge the gap; Bonus: experience building AI-driven qualification or scoring systems; a B2B SaaS background with multiple product lines, ideally product-led or demo-led; published technical content that makes complex systems accessible. Most of this sounds like you? Apply. What the job comes with Base salary: $110,000 - $140,000. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions. OTE: $120,000 - $155,000 LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth. RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget. Flexible vacation policy. Remote work, with access to our Montreal office. In-person gathering twice a year. Claude access, for everyone. Note: The internal title for this role is GTM Architect. What drives us At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level. We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home. We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment. If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it. How we hire Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us. Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call. We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human. We can't wait to meet you. By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy . #LI-Remote

  • Hands-on experience with low-code orchestration (n8n, Make, Zapier or similar), plus working knowledge of Python or TypeScript for API integrations and data transformation;
  • fluency with agentic tools and MCP connectors. Strong LLM workflow design (agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation), sound judgment on when AI adds leverage versus complexity, and a track record of shipping AI agents or LLM workflows to real users, not just prototypes;
  • Working SQL to query and validate usage, support and renewal data., so you can build and trust the data behind your agents;
  • CRM fluency (HubSpot a plus): enough to design agents on our data model and work with Revenue Systems on what you need.
  • Understanding of subscription business metrics (renewal rate, net retention, customer lifetime value), and experience with or strong interest in outbound and signal-based go-to-market motions;
  • The ability to work directly with Sales and Account Management, translate complex builds into plain language, and earn adoption through demos and handoff docs, without a PM to bridge the gap;
  • Bonus: experience building AI-driven qualification or scoring systems; a B2B SaaS background with multiple product lines, ideally product-led or demo-led; published technical content that makes complex systems accessible.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $110,000 - $140,000. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
    • OTE: $120,000 - $155,000
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gathering twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

Note: The internal title for this role is GTM Architect.

What drives us

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy.
